The mapper shapes it to minimize photometric error, often flattening it against surfaces, while robust registration typically benefits from measurement uncertainty. We propose a dual-covariance parameterization. Each Gaussian keeps a single mean but holds two covariances: a rendering covariance optimized by the mapper, and a tracking covariance derived from an RGB-D sensor noise model. We further use the tracking covariances as Gaussian anchors for image corners, providing constraints in directions where depth geometry is weak. We evaluate on TUM RGB-D, ScanNet, Replica, and two outdoor sequences recorded with a RealSense D435i on wheeled and handheld platforms. We achieve robust tracking performance across multiple scenes and reduced odometry drift, while tracking at $\sim$ 60 FPS.

AI.tldr: 提出双协方差参数化3DGS SLAM方法，将渲染协方差与跟踪协方差解耦，并用跟踪协方差作为角点锚点，在多个数据集上实现鲁棒跟踪与更低漂移，跟踪速度约60 FPS。
AI.motivation: 基于ICP的3DGS SLAM中，同一高斯的协方差同时服务于渲染与配准，二者需求冲突：建图希望最小化光度误差而将协方差压扁贴合表面，而鲁棒配准更需要反映测量不确定性。单一协方差难以同时满足这两个目标。
AI.method: 提出双协方差参数化：每个高斯仅保留一个均值，但维护两个协方差——由建图模块优化的渲染协方差，以及基于RGB-D传感器噪声模型导出的跟踪协方差。此外，将跟踪协方差用作图像角点的高斯锚点，在深度几何约束较弱的区域提供额外约束方向。
AI.result: 在TUM RGB-D、ScanNet、Replica以及RealSense D435i采集的两段轮式与手持室外序列上进行评估，在多种场景下实现鲁棒跟踪，减少了里程计漂移，同时跟踪速度约60 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 将渲染与跟踪的协方差解耦可有效缓解二者目标冲突，提升3DGS SLAM的跟踪鲁棒性并降低漂移，且保持实时性能，验证了双协方差设计与角点锚点约束的有效性。

title: Syndrome, Synergy, and Safety: Structured Reasoning and Knowledge-Driven Alignment for TCM Prescription Generation
summary: Applying large language models to Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) prescription generation reveals three clinically critical gaps: models produce end-to-end mappings without auditable reasoning following the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm (SR Gap), treat each encounter in isolation without follow-up adjustment via sui zheng jia jian (LA Gap), and fail to enforce absolute contraindication rules such as Shi Ba Fan (SC Gap). We propose a progressive four-stage framework (SFT $\to$ PG-CoT $\to$ Dynamic $\to$ K-RL) that addresses each gap: PG-CoT constrains CoT distillation under the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm to produce auditable diagnostic chains, Dynamic SFT models patient trajectories with explicit transition reasoning, and K-RL encodes deterministic pharmacological rules as rule-based DPO preference signals. Across 12 fine-tuned models and 6 zero-shot baselines, our framework substantially improves prescription quality over zero-shot baselines---with a 7B model (Mistral-7B) surpassing zero-shot GPT-5 on all three TCM evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大语言模型在中医处方生成中的三大临床关键缺陷，提出四阶段渐进框架（SFT→PG-CoT→Dynamic→K-RL）予以解决，并验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型应用于中医处方生成存在三个临床关键缺陷：（1）SR Gap——模型进行端到端映射，缺乏遵循"理法方药"范式的可审计推理；（2）LA Gap——每次就诊被孤立处理，无法通过"随证加减"进行随访调整；（3）SC Gap——未能强制实施"十八反"等绝对禁忌规则。这三类缺口严重影响处方的临床可信度与安全性。
AI.method: 提出渐进式四阶段框架：SFT（监督微调）→ PG-CoT（在"理法方药"范式约束下进行思维链蒸馏，生成可审计的诊断链）→ Dynamic（动态SFT，对患者病程轨迹建模并引入显式转换推理，实现随证加减）→ K-RL（将确定性药理规则编码为基于规则的DPO偏好信号，强化禁忌约束）。
AI.result: 在12个微调模型与6个零样本基线的对比实验中，该框架在处方质量上较零样本基线显著提升；其中7B模型（Mistral-7B）在全部三项中医评价指标上均超越零样本GPT-5。
AI.conclusion: 通过分阶段、针对性地弥补推理可审计性、随访动态调整与绝对禁忌约束三方面缺口，该渐进式框架有效提升了中医处方生成的质量与安全性，且较小规模模型经此训练后可优于大规模零样本模型。

title: Reading Right, Answering Wrong: How Visual Configuration Changes Affect Evidence Use in VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as visual question answering, yet small image resizes can turn correct answers into errors. We investigate whether changes in visual configuration, such as image tiling and token arrangement, contribute to this instability. Across seven checkpoints and four benchmarks, equally small resizes cause more correctness flips when they switch configurations. Surprisingly, in over half of these cases, models answer the question incorrectly but can still read the correct answer when told what to read. Furthermore, attention interventions in LLaVA-NeXT suggest that configuration changes can weaken the use of readable information during answering. We therefore guide models using field cues and their own transcriptions. With annotation assistance, these forms of guidance together correct 97.2% of errors with readable information. These findings show that configuration changes can affect how models use information they can still read.

AI.tldr: 视觉配置变化（图像切分、token排列）会导致小尺寸缩放后答案翻转，且模型虽能读出正确内容仍答错，通过引导可纠正97.2%此类错误。
AI.motivation: 探究为何微小图像缩放会使原本正确的VLM答案出错，重点考察视觉配置变化（如切分与token排列）是否是导致不稳定性的关键因素。
AI.method: 在7个模型checkpoint与4个基准上对比等幅度缩放是否伴随配置切换；通过"告知读什么"测试模型能否读出正确答案；在LLaVA-NeXT上进行注意力干预；并利用区域线索（field cues）与模型自身转录（transcriptions）进行引导。
AI.result: 当缩放伴随配置切换时，等幅度缩放引发更多正确性翻转；超过半数错误案例中，模型虽答错但被提示后能读出正确答案；注意力干预表明配置变化削弱了作答时对可读信息的使用；在标注辅助下，两种引导方式结合纠正了97.2%具有可读信息的错误。
AI.conclusion: 视觉配置变化会影响模型对其仍可读取信息的使用方式，而非仅影响信息可获取性；针对性引导可有效纠正此类错误。

title: Video-HopChain: Multi-Hop Questions and Confidence-Gated Exploration for Video Reasoning Models
summary: HopChain has shown on still images that multi-hop data synthesis improves vision-language reasoning, because long chain-of-thought reasoning exposes errors that compound across steps, while most data used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rarely demands a chain of visual evidence, so these weaknesses are likely to stay unexposed. We observe the same problem in video, where this framework has not yet been explored. We therefore build Video-HopChain, a dataset of 22,550 multi-hop video questions over 13,378 videos, together with a held-out benchmark of 1,000 questions. Each question chains three to six yes/no questions about moments in one video, and each yields one of two integers depending on its answer. The final answer is the sum of these integers, so an exact match on that sum gives the verifiable reward that RLVR needs. We first train Qwen3-VL-8B with GRPO on a standard video dataset, and a second stage on Video-HopChain then raises the mean over eight video understanding and reasoning benchmarks from 55.4 to 57.9 and improves every one of them. Training on such a dataset, however, exposes a known limitation of GRPO: its learning signal comes from the reward variance within a group, so hard questions whose rollouts are all incorrect and easy questions whose rollouts are all correct both leave the group with no gradient. To recover these groups at the same compute budget, we introduce Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE). With 8 rollouts per question, CGE samples the first 4 as usual. If these 4 are either all correct or all incorrect, it samples the last 4 with the policy's most confident token masked inside the reasoning span, and removes the masked positions from the loss while all 8 rollouts enter the advantage. With CGE, the mean rises further to 59.3. We release the dataset, the checkpoint, and the data generation and training code.

AI.tldr: 构建 Video-HopChain 多跳视频数据集并提出 CGE 方法，配合 GRPO 两阶段训练提升视频理解与推理基准表现。
AI.motivation: HopChain 已证明多跳数据合成能提升视觉语言推理，因为长链式推理会暴露逐步累积的错误，而 RLVR 常用数据少有视觉证据链需求，导致此类缺陷难以暴露；视频领域尚无该框架探索。
AI.method: 构建 Video-HopChain：22,550 道多跳视频问题、覆盖 13,378 个视频，附 1,000 题留出基准；每题串联 3–6 个关于同一视频时间片段的 yes/no 子问题，答案映射为两个整数，最终答案为其和，精确匹配即可作为可验证奖励。先以 GRPO 在标准视频数据上训练 Qwen3-VL-8B，第二阶段在 Video-HopChain 上训练。针对 GRPO 组内奖励方差为零导致无梯度的问题，提出 Confidence-Gated Exploration (CGE)：每题 8 次 rollout，前 4 次常规采样；若全对或全错，则在推理区间内屏蔽策略最置信的 token 采样后 4 次，并将被屏蔽位置从损失中剔除，而全部 8 次 rollout 均参与优势计算。
AI.result: 第二阶段训练将 8 个视频理解与推理基准的均值从 55.4 提升至 57.9，且每个基准均有改善；加入 CGE 后均值进一步提升至 59.3。
AI.conclusion: 多跳视频数据合成能有效提升视频语言推理能力，CGE 可在同等算力预算下恢复 GRPO 中无梯度样本组的学习信号；作者开源数据集、检查点及数据生成与训练代码。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Representation and Consistency Estimation for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: Recent advances in generative video models have enabled the synthesis of visually realistic content, posing significant challenges to synthetic video detection. Existing detectors often rely on appearance artifacts, semantic inconsistencies, and temporal patterns that may be generator-specific, limitating generalization to unseen synthesis models. We investigate whether responses to a pretrained generative model provide more transferable forensic cues. Our key observation is that real and AI-generated videos exhibit distinct \emph{velocity responses} under a pretrained Flow Matching video model. This distinction persists when different pretrained video-generation backbones are used as probes, suggesting that velocity responses offer transferable forensic signals beyond visual artificts. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{TRACE} (\emph{\underline{T}rajectory \underline{R}epresentation \underline{a}nd \underline{C}onsistency \underline{E}stimation}), a generation-process-aware framework for AI-generated video detection. TRACE leverages a pretrained video DiT as a velocity-field probe to extract representations at multiple flow time points, and models cross-frame consistency through velocity differences between adjacent frames. We further introduce a \emph{Real-Centered Trajectory Optimization} objective that encourages generator-invariant representation learning. Extensive experiments on AIGVDBench demonstrate that TRACE generalizes effectively across diverse generators, substantially outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods on unseen open- and closed-source video generation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE框架，利用预训练Flow Matching视频模型作为速度场探针提取轨迹表示与跨帧一致性，用于AI生成视频检测，在AIGVDBench上跨生成器泛化性能显著优于现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有生成视频检测器依赖外观伪影、语义不一致与时序模式等线索，这些线索往往与特定生成器绑定，导致对未见合成模型泛化能力受限。作者希望寻找更具可迁移性的取证信号。
AI.method: 核心观察是真实视频与AI生成视频在预训练Flow Matching视频模型下呈现不同的"速度响应"，且该差异在更换不同预训练视频生成骨干作为探针时依然存在，说明其可作为可迁移取证信号。据此提出TRACE框架：以预训练视频DiT作为速度场探针，在多个flow时间点提取表示；通过相邻帧速度差建模跨帧一致性；并引入Real-Centered Trajectory Optimization目标促进生成器不变的表示学习。
AI.result: 在AIGVDBench上的大量实验表明，TRACE在多种生成器间泛化良好，在未见过的开源与闭源视频生成模型上大幅超越先前SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于生成过程内部速度响应（而非外观伪影）的取证线索更具可迁移性，生成过程感知的TRACE框架为跨生成器AI视频检测提供了有效方案。

title: When Point Clouds Outperform Pixels: Rethinking Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection
summary: Zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection commonly assumes that RGB and point cloud modalities are equally reliable and can contribute uniformly to anomaly localization. We challenge this assumption. Using a set of recently proposed stringent metrics that penalize false anomaly responses in normal regions, we find that point clouds are substantially more reliable than RGB under zero-shot category shift. Motivated by this observation, we propose WOOPS (\textbf{W}hen P\textbf{o}int Cl\textbf{o}uds Out\textbf{p}erform Pixel\textbf{s}), a reliability-aware zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection framework. To strengthen the more reliable geometric modality, we design a Multi-view Information Decoupling module to suppress heterogeneous information from multi-view point cloud projections and enhance point cloud feature quality. To avoid unconditional fusion, we further introduce a Modality Reliability Calibration module to adaptively calibrate modality contributions according to their reliability. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves the best or competitive performance under the new metrics in both unimodal and multimodal settings. Further analysis demonstrates that point cloud information also improves RGB-only inference, while ablations verify the effectiveness of both modules. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战零样本多模态异常检测中"RGB与点云同等可靠"的假设，发现类别迁移下点云比RGB更可靠，据此提出可靠性感知框架WOOPS，通过多视角信息解耦与模态可靠性校准模块提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本多模态异常检测普遍假设RGB与点云模态同等可靠、对异常定位贡献一致，但作者利用近期提出的严格指标（惩罚正常区域中的假异常响应）验证发现：在零样本类别迁移条件下，点云的可靠性显著高于RGB。因此需要一种可靠性感知的检测框架来纠正这一错误假设。
AI.method: 提出WOOPS（When Point Clouds Outperform Pixels）可靠性感知零样本多模态异常检测框架，包含两个核心模块：1）多视角信息解耦模块（Multi-view Information Decoupling），用于抑制多视角点云投影中的异质信息、增强更可靠的几何模态特征质量；2）模态可靠性校准模块（Modality Reliability Calibration），依据各模态可靠性自适应校准其贡献，避免无条件融合。
AI.result: 在新指标下，方法在单模态与多模态设置中均取得最优或具竞争力的性能；进一步分析表明点云信息还能提升纯RGB推理效果，消融实验验证了两个模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 点云在零样本类别迁移下比RGB更可靠，可靠性感知的多模态融合优于无条件融合；所提两个模块经验证有效，代码将在录用后发布。

title: Reply to comments arXiv:2512.07881 and arXiv:2601.06104 on quantum structure in human and AI-generated language
comment: Reply to comments arXiv:2512.07881 and arXiv:2601.06104, 6 pages
summary: We reply to the comments by M. Sienicki and K. Sienicki (arXiv:2512.07881) and by K. Sienicki (arXiv:2601.06104) on our work on quantum-mechanical statistics in human language (arXiv:2407.14924) and on quantum structure in AI-generated language (arXiv:2511.21731). We thank the authors for their careful reading and address what we consider to be the main points of criticism: the exploratory nature of the protocol used in the experiments with large language models; the role of marginal-law violations, and of the Contextuality-by-Default criterion, in the identification of entanglement; the limited diagnostic value of a Bose-Einstein fit taken in isolation; the meaning of assigning the lowest energy levels to the most frequent words; and the relation between the vector spaces used by LLMs and quantum state spaces. We also correct a typographical error in Table 3 of arXiv:2511.21731, which does not affect the reported CHSH value.

AI.tldr: 本文是对两篇评论文章的回复，回应了关于人类语言量子统计与AI生成语言量子结构研究的主要批评，并更正了一处笔误。
AI.motivation: M. Sienicki、K. Sienicki 及 K. Sienicki 分别对作者关于人类语言量子力学统计（arXiv:2407.14924）和AI生成语言量子结构（arXiv:2511.21731）的工作提出评论，作者认为有必要对其中若干核心批评予以回应与澄清。
AI.method: 采用学术答复（reply）的形式，逐条针对评论中的批评点进行回应与辩护，涵盖协议的探索性质、边缘分布律违背与 Contextuality-by-Default 判据的作用、玻色-爱因斯坦拟合的诊断价值、最低能级与高频词对应关系的含义，以及LLM向量空间与量子态空间的关系。
AI.result: 逐一回应了所列举的各项批评，并更正了 arXiv:2511.21731 表3中的一处排版错误，同时指出该更正不影响所报告的 CHSH 值。
AI.conclusion: 作者感谢评论者的细致阅读，重申并澄清了其研究在方法学与解释上的立场，同时确认笔误更正不改变原有结论。

title: Latest Exact Match Attention
summary: We introduce latest exact match attention (LEMA), an attention variant for transformers where queries and keys are binarized and each query attends only to the latest exactly matching key. We prove that LEMA transformers with chain of thought can simulate word-RAMs, as was recently shown for the less restrictive rightmost hard attention. In contrast to prior hard attention variants, the restriction to exact matches enables an efficient converse direction: word-RAMs can simulate LEMA transformers at a cost per token independent of the context length. Together, these results yield a close correspondence between the two computational models in terms of both compute and memory. Beyond the theory, we propose a training method for LEMA transformers that handles their non-differentiable operations with a straight-through estimator for the binarization and a soft attention surrogate annealed towards LEMA. On a synthetic associative recall task, LEMA models trained this way use their growing state to store and recall a large number of associations, outperforming gated DeltaNet (GDN) with its fixed state size. As a first scaling test, we train LEMA language models with up to 834 million parameters. They match softmax transformers of around half their size in loss and, on repeated rare phrases and a needle-retrieval task, remain behind softmax transformers but recall across longer distances than GDN models of comparable size. Finally, we implement dictionary-based inference for LEMA transformers and show constant generation speed comparable to GDN despite their growing state, with the dictionaries residing in main memory rather than VRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/moritzbroe/latest_exact_match_attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lema（latest exact match attention），一种查询与键均二值化、每个查询仅关注最近精确匹配键的注意力变体。理论上证明带思维链的Lema Transformer可模拟word-RAM，且word-RAM亦能以与上下文长度无关的代价模拟Lema Transformer，二者在计算与内存上高度对应。
AI.motivation: 现有hard attention（如rightmost hard attention）虽可被证明模拟word-RAM，但缺乏高效的反向模拟，难以建立两种模型间的紧密对应。作者希望设计一种限制更强的注意力机制，在保留表达能力的同时获得可高效模拟的逆方向。
AI.method: 将查询与键二值化，每个查询只关注最近一个精确匹配的键（Lema）。训练上采用直通估计器处理二值化的不可微操作，并用退火趋向Lema的soft attention代理。推理时实现基于字典的推断，字典存放于主内存而非显存。
AI.result: 理论上Lema Transformer与word-RAM在计算与内存上形成紧密对应。合成联想召回任务中，Lema利用增长的状态存储并召回大量关联，优于固定状态大小的GDN。扩展到834M参数的语言模型，损失匹敌约一半规模的softmax Transformer；在重复罕见短语与针检索任务上落后于softmax Transformer，但跨距离召回能力优于同规模GDN。字典式推理实现与GDN相当的常数生成速度。
AI.conclusion: Lema在理论上与word-RAM形成双向高效模拟的紧密对应，在实践上通过定制训练与字典式推理，实现了增长状态下的常数生成速度，在长距离召回上展现出相对固定状态模型的优势，为高效注意力变体提供了新方向。

title: LiFR v2: Completion-Augmented Event Propagation for High-Rate Dense Prediction
summary: High-rate dense perception in dynamic environments is limited by the low update rate of RGB cameras, as rapid scene changes can occur between frames. Event cameras offer temporally dense but spatially sparse measurements, complementary to spatially dense RGB observations. Direct fusion cannot fully exploit this complementarity, while event-guided propagation fails on newly appearing or disoccluded regions without valid RGB support. We present LiFR v2, a unified propagation-completion-memory framework for causal anytime and streaming dense prediction from an RGB keyframe and events. LiFR v2 introduces an Event-Guided Completion Module (EGCM) to recover task-relevant representations where propagation is unsupported, and a History Retrieval Module (HRM) to reuse completed representations across successive queries. The framework supports semantic segmentation, monocular depth estimation, and multi-task dense prediction, and we further introduce SHF-Emerge to evaluate rapid object emergence and disocclusion. LiFR v2 achieves 74.37% mIoU on DSEC and 56.13% on SHF-Emerge, improving LiFR-Seg by 1.85 percentage points on the latter, while reducing SHF-Emerge depth RMSE from 1.564 m to 1.118 m over the propagation baseline. It also exceeds 100 FPS for both segmentation and depth, demonstrating accurate and efficient high-rate perception beyond RGB frame rates.

AI.tldr: LiFR v2 提出统一的传播-补全-记忆框架，从RGB关键帧与事件流进行因果式任意时刻/流式稠密预测，支持语义分割、单目深度与多任务密集预测。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中高帧率稠密感知受限于RGB相机低更新率，帧间易发生快速场景变化；事件相机时间稠密但空间稀疏，与RGB互补。直接融合无法充分利用互补性，而事件引导传播在新出现或被遮挡揭示区域因缺少有效RGB支撑而失效。
AI.method: 引入事件引导补全模块（EGCM），在传播无法支撑处恢复任务相关表征；引入历史检索模块（HRM），在连续查询间复用已补全表征；并构建SHF-Emerge数据集以评估快速物体出现与遮挡揭示场景。
AI.result: 在DSEC上达到74.37% mIoU，在SHF-Emerge上达56.13% mIoU，较LiFR-Seg提升1.85个百分点；SHF-Emerge深度RMSE由传播基线的1.564 m降至1.118 m；分割与深度均超过100 FPS。
AI.conclusion: LiFR v2 实现了超越RGB帧率的准确、高效高帧率稠密感知，验证了传播-补全-记忆统一框架在任意时刻与流式密集预测中的有效性。

title: Auditing Proxy-Based Validation Across Text Spans
summary: Evaluation scores are often validated by their agreement with inexpensive proxy labels. When the score and the proxy are computed from the same text span, however, that agreement can arise from surface evidence the two share rather than from the semantic construct the proxy is meant to represent. We make the distinction explicit by declaring the score, its span, the proxy and the target construct as a validation contract, then re-evaluating that proxy rule strictly outside the scored span. In a controlled HotpotQA correctness experiment varying only the shared text boundary, the score agrees with its proxy far better than with correctness at a 50-character prefix: the gap is +0.184, collapsing to at most +0.045 from 120 characters onward. At that short prefix the score still predicts whether the answer string appears later (AUC 0.634) while an equivalence test places its agreement with correctness at chance, so the reported proxy agreement does not establish that the score ranks correctness. On OR-Bench, suppressing each model's recurring opening templates removes most of the score's association with the refusal proxy, while matched-volume deletion removes almost none and construct agreement stays at chance. Only three of eleven external contracts support the off-span control, and none of the routing studies we sampled released the generations it needs. We therefore ask that a proxy-based validation claim declare the span each label is read from, report the construct agreement beside the proxy agreement, and release the generations that let the proxy be re-read off the scored span.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"验证契约"框架，将分数、其文本跨度、代理标签与目标构念显式区分，并在评分跨度之外重新评估代理规则。HotpotQA实验显示，在50字符前缀处分数与代理的一致性比与正确性的一致性高出+0.184，但自120字符起该差距骤降至至多+0.045，且此时与正确性的一致性处于随机水平。OR-Bench上，抑制模型固定的开头模板会消除分数与拒绝代理的大部分关联。作者呼吁代理验证类研究须声明标签读取跨度、同时报告构念一致性与代理一致性，并公开可用于跨跨度重读的生成文本。
AI.motivation: 评估分数常通过与低成本代理标签的一致性来验证。但当分数与代理从同一文本跨度计算时，二者的一致性可能来自共享的表面证据，而非代理本应代表的语义构念，从而造成验证假象。论文旨在明确并量化这一混淆。
AI.method: 提出"验证契约"：显式声明分数、其跨度、代理与目标构念四要素，并将代理规则严格置于被评分跨度之外重新评估。在HotpotQA上设计仅改变共享文本边界的正确性对照实验（50字符前缀至120字符以后）；在OR-Bench上通过抑制模型反复出现的开头模板与等量删除进行对照；另调查11个外部契约是否支持跨度外控制，以及抽样路由研究是否公开所需生成文本。
AI.result: HotpotQA：50字符前缀处分数与代理一致性远高于与正确性的一致性（差距+0.184），120字符起差距缩至至多+0.045；该短前缀下分数仍能预测答案串是否在后文出现（AUC 0.634），而等价检验显示其与正确性的一致性等于随机。OR-Bench：抑制开头模板消除分数与拒绝代理的大部分关联，等量删除几乎无影响，且构念一致性始终为随机水平。11个外部契约中仅3个支持跨度外控制；抽样的路由研究均未公开所需生成文本。
AI.conclusion: 同一跨度内计算的代理一致性不能确立分数对目标构念的排序能力，可能仅反映共享的表面线索。代理验证类主张应声明每个标签的读取跨度、在代理一致性旁并列报告构念一致性，并公开允许代理在评分跨度外被重新读取的生成文本。

title: MorphoSHAP: Rethinking the Unit of Attribution in Explanation for Deep Visual Models
summary: Visual attribution methods typically explain predictions using pixels, superpixels, or regular patches. These representations can localize important regions, but provide limited information about their structure. We introduce MorphoSHAP, a model-agnostic post-hoc method that instead uses morphological shapes as the players of a Shapley attribution game. Using the Tree of Shapes, each shape is described by its scale, geometry, and signed contribution, providing explanations of where the evidence lies, what type of structure carries it, and how strongly it affects the prediction. This shared morphological vocabulary enables spatial, textual, and global class-level explanations beyond image-specific heatmaps. To the best of our knowledge, MorphoSHAP is the first SHAP-based image attribution framework to combine these different forms of explanation. Across five diverse datasets and three architectures, MorphoSHAP achieves strong insertion/deletion performance and outperforms competing attribution methods on several benchmarks. Finally, a user study shows that MorphoSHAP provides explanations that are easy to use and are preferred over standard attribution baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MorphoSHAP，一种模型无关的事后归因方法，以形态学形状作为Shapley博弈中的参与者，提供空间、文本与全局类别级的多形式解释。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉归因方法多基于像素、超像素或规则块，虽能定位重要区域，但对其结构信息刻画有限。作者希望用能表达尺度与几何结构的形态学形状替代传统参与者，从而提供更丰富的解释形式。
AI.method: MorphoSHAP是一种模型无关的事后方法，将形态学形状作为Shapley归因博弈的玩家。基于Tree of Shapes，每个形状由尺度、几何与带符号贡献描述，从而说明证据所在位置、承载结构类型及其对预测的影响强度。该共享形态学词汇支持空间、文本与全局类别级解释。
AI.result: 在五个不同数据集和三种架构上，MorphoSHAP取得较强的插入/删除性能，并在若干基准上优于竞争归因方法。用户研究表明其解释易于使用，且相比标准归因基线更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，MorphoSHAP是首个结合上述不同解释形式的基于SHAP的图像归因框架，验证了以形态学形状为参与者进行归因的有效性与可用性。

title: SWT: Self-Supervised Video Object Segmentation via Sliding, Wavelet and Transportation
summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) aims to accurately segment target objects from consecutive video frames and track the changes of the objects in each frame of the video. Conventional VOS methods typically demand substantial quantities of pixel-level labeled video sequences for fully supervised learning, which limits the performance of the model in sparse video scenes, while existing VOS methods have limited adaptability to global changes in objects. Based on this observation, in this paper, we propose self-supervised VOS with Sliding window, Wavelet transform and optimal Transport (SWT), a self-supervised VOS framework entirely trained on static dataset using contrastive learning. Firstly, a rolling sample buffer reuses overlapping groups of independently sampled images across successive updates. Secondly, to address the long-distance modeling difficulty caused by simple convolutional structures, we introduce wavelet transform to expand the receptive field of convolutional kernels, thus improving the model's representational capability. Finally, we incorporate optimal transport to assist the model in finding the globally optimal match between the target across two frames, improving the model's ability to handle nonrigid deformations of objects. SWT only requires training on the COCO dataset once and achieves excellent results on five VOS datasets as well as an additional body part propagation dataset. The code will be released soon at [https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git](https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git).

AI.tldr: 提出自监督视频目标分割框架SWT，融合滑动窗口、小波变换与最优传输，仅用COCO训练一次即在五个VOS数据集及一个身体部位传播数据集上取得优异结果。
AI.motivation: 传统VOS方法依赖大量像素级标注视频做全监督学习，在稀疏视频场景下性能受限，且现有方法对目标的全局变化适应性不足。
AI.method: 基于对比学习的全自监督VOS框架，仅在静态数据集上训练。包含三个组件：一是滚动采样缓冲区（滑动窗口），在连续更新中复用独立采样图像的重叠组；二是引入小波变换扩展卷积核感受野，解决简单卷积结构的长距离建模困难；三是引入最优传输，帮助模型在跨帧目标间寻找全局最优匹配。
AI.result: 仅需在COCO数据集上训练一次，即在五个VOS数据集及一个额外的身体部位传播数据集上取得优异结果。
AI.conclusion: SWT以自监督方式有效缓解视频标注依赖，通过小波变换与最优传输提升全局建模与非刚性形变处理能力，代码将开源。

title: Sometimes You Gotta Run Before You Can Walk: Run-then-Walk Scheduling Strategy for VLM Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent VLM-based autonomous driving planners adopt GRPO-style reinforcement learning to optimize driving performance. However, existing GRPO recipes either optimize driving efficiency, risking progress-seeking but unsafe behavior, or enforce early safety constraints, leading to overly conservative behavior; both require lengthy training. To solve these problems, we first reveal two distinct RL regimes: a progress regime (Run-GRPO) that aggressively explores high progress, and a safety regime (Walk-GRPO) that restores safety under stable progress. Based on this finding, we propose $\textit{Run-then-Walk}$, a simple yet effective two-stage reward scheduling strategy for GRPO, achieving both better performance and faster convergence. Unlike one-stage RL, which may focus on progress, safety, or a mixture of both within a single training phase, this schedule explicitly separates progress discovery from safety repair. In the $\textit{Run}$ phase, we focus on progress, allowing the policy to escape the conservative bias and discover high-progress modes. In the subsequent $\textit{Walk}$ phase, we introduce endpoint and safety strategy to repair unsafe behaviors from the Run phase. This reversed schedule overcomes the conservatism of Walk-first methods and the unsafe progress-seeking of joint optimization. We validate it with various VLM-based planners on multiple benchmarks: NAVSIMv1, NAVSIMv2, Navhard, and nuScenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved driving performance while requiring 40--50\% fewer RL training epochs than the baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/haha-yuki-haha/AutoDrive-P3_with_Run-then-walk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Run-then-Walk 两阶段奖励调度策略，用于 VLM 自动驾驶规划器的 GRPO 强化学习，先探索高进度再修复安全性，性能更优且训练轮次减少 40–50%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 VLM 的自动驾驶规划器采用 GRPO 式强化学习时存在两难：优化驾驶效率会导致激进探索、安全性不足；而强制早期安全约束又会导致过度保守。两类方法均需较长训练时间，难以兼顾性能与收敛速度。
AI.method: 作者首先揭示两种不同的强化学习机制：进度机制（Run-GRPO）激进探索高进度，安全机制（Walk-GRPO）在稳定进度下恢复安全性。据此提出 Run-then-Walk 两阶段奖励调度：Run 阶段聚焦进度，使策略摆脱保守偏置、发现高进度模式；Walk 阶段引入终点与安全策略，修复 Run 阶段的不安全行为。该反向调度区别于单阶段 RL 或 Walk-first 方法。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard、nuScenes 多个基准上，使用多种 VLM 规划器验证：驾驶性能提升，且相比基线减少 40–50% 的 RL 训练轮次。
AI.conclusion: 将进度发现与安全修复显式分离的两阶段调度，能够克服保守性与不安全激进探索之间的矛盾，实现更优性能与更快收敛，为 VLM 自动驾驶规划器的 GRPO 训练提供了简洁有效的方案。

title: PartLLM: A Unified Multimodal Foundation for 3D Part Segmentation
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (ACM Transactions on Graphics). Project Page: https://czvvd.github.io/PartLLMPage/
summary: Part segmentation is a fundamental problem in computer graphics and 3D vision. Recent works have expanded 3D part segmentation beyond fixed taxonomies, but existing approaches typically only address a specific setting, such as text-guided part segmentation or point-based interaction. In this work, we argue that these settings can be unified as an intent-conditioned generative problem, where different prompts specify the desired part decomposition. To this end, we introduce PartLLM, a unified multimodal model that formulates 3D part segmentation as autoregressive semantic decomposition. Conditioned on an input shape and a user prompt, PartLLM autoregressively generates semantic part hypotheses as queries for mask prediction and feeds them to a decomposition-aware decoder that jointly predicts coherent part masks. This unified design supports text-guided part segmentation, interactive segmentation, and full-shape semantic decomposition with controllable granularity within a single model. Extensive experiments across these task settings show that PartLLM consistently outperforms task-specific baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of unifying 3D part segmentation under an intent-conditioned generative formulation.

AI.tldr: PartLLM将3D部件分割统一为意图条件生成问题，通过自回归语义分解实现文本引导、交互式及全形状可控粒度分割，性能优于各任务专用基线。
AI.motivation: 现有3D部件分割工作虽突破了固定分类体系，但通常只针对单一设定（如文本引导分割或基于点的交互），缺乏统一框架。作者认为这些设定本质上可统一为"意图条件生成"问题，不同提示对应不同的部件分解需求。
AI.method: 提出PartLLM统一多模态模型，将3D部件分割建模为自回归语义分解。在输入形状与用户提示条件下，自回归生成语义部件假设作为查询，喂入分解感知解码器联合预测连贯的部件掩码。
AI.result: 在多种任务设定下的大量实验表明，PartLLM一致优于各任务专用基线，验证了意图条件生成式统一公式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 单一模型即可支持文本引导分割、交互式分割以及可控粒度的全形状语义分解，证明将3D部件分割统一为意图条件生成问题是可行且有效的。

title: ARAFA: An LLM-Generated Arabic Fact-Checking Dataset
summary: Automatic fact-checking poses a significant challenge in Arabic natural language processing due to the scarcity of datasets and resources. In this manuscript, we introduce Arafa, a new large-scale dataset for fact-checking in Modern Standard Arabic, constructed through an automated framework leveraging large language models (LLMs). The dataset was constructed through a three-step pipeline: (1) claim generation from Arabic Wikipedia pages with supporting textual evidence, (2) claim mutation to generate challenging counterfactual claims with refuting evidence, and (3) an automatic validation step to validate that the generated claims are either supported or refuted by their accompanying evidence, or if the evidence does not provide enough information to judge the validity of the claims. The resulting dataset comprises 181,976 claim-evidence pairs labeled as supported, refuted, or not enough information. Human evaluation carried out on a test sample from the dataset demonstrated strong inter-annotator agreement (kappa = 0.89) using Cohen's Kappa for supported claims and (kappa = 0.94) for refuted claims. Automatic validation based on a human-evaluated sample achieved 86% accuracy for supported claims and 88% for refuted ones. To showcase Arafa's value as a resource for automatic Arabic fact-checking, four open-source transformer-based models were fine-tuned using Arafa, with the top-performing model achieving a Macro F1-score of 77% on the test data. In addition to Arafa being the first large-scale dataset for Arabic fact-checking, our framework presents a scalable approach for developing similar resources for other low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Arafa——首个大规模现代标准阿拉伯语事实核查数据集（181,976条claim-evidence对），通过LLM驱动的三步流水线构建，含人工验证与多模型微调实验。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语自动事实核查因数据集与资源稀缺而面临重大挑战，缺乏大规模、带标注的核查语料，限制了相关模型的发展，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建LLM驱动的三步流水线：(1) 从阿拉伯语维基百科页面生成带支持性证据的claim；(2) 对claim进行变异，生成带有反驳证据的、具挑战性的反事实claim；(3) 自动验证步骤，判定claim被证据支持、被反驳，或证据信息不足。最终获得181,976条claim-evidence对，标签为supported/refuted/not enough information。
AI.result: 人工评估显示标注者间一致性较高（supported的Cohen's Kappa=0.89，refuted=0.94）；自动验证在人工评估样本上对supported达86%准确率、refuted达88%。微调四个开源Transformer模型，最优模型测试集Macro F1为77%。
AI.conclusion: Arafa是首个大规模阿拉伯语事实核查数据集，验证了其作为自动阿拉伯语事实核查资源的有效性；所提框架具备可扩展性，可为其他低资源语言构建类似资源。

title: Identity-Centric Video Summarization via Hierarchical Fusion of Biometric, Appearance, and 3D Body Features
summary: This work presents a video summarization algorithm based on multi-object tracking and person reidentification. We integrate facial embeddings, 3D body-shape features, and visual appearance into a unified tracking framework. These representations enable hierarchical identity assignment and tracking through bidirectional anchoring, which robustly recovers trajectories under severe occlusion or low visual quality. From these stable trajectories, we generate a compact set of summaries for each identity. We select keyframes using a multi-factor weighting scheme that optimizes biometric clarity, social interaction, and motion dynamics, while Adaptive Non-Maximum Suppression ensures temporal diversity. Evaluation on a custom dataset demonstrates tracking stability, achieving an IDF1 of 97.89% and a MOTA of 95.79%. Compared to Top-K selection, our algorithm also increases visual diversity by 146%, temporal coverage by 89%, and information retrievability by 3.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出基于多目标跟踪与行人重识别的视频摘要算法，融合人脸嵌入、3D体型特征与视觉外观，通过双向锚定实现分层身份关联与跟踪，在遮挡和低画质下稳定恢复轨迹，并按身份生成具有生物特征清晰度、社交交互与运动动态的多样化关键帧摘要。
AI.motivation: 在严重遮挡或低视觉质量条件下，传统视频摘要难以稳定保持身份一致性与轨迹连续性，导致摘要内容冗余、时序覆盖不足，因此需要将跟踪与重识别深度结合以生成按身份组织的紧凑摘要。
AI.method: 将人脸嵌入、3D体型特征与视觉外观统一到跟踪框架中；采用分层身份分配与双向锚定机制进行轨迹恢复；在稳定轨迹上按身份选取关键帧，使用多因素加权方案优化生物特征清晰度、社交交互与运动动态，并以自适应非极大值抑制（ANMS）保证时间多样性。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上，跟踪性能达到 IDF1 97.89%、MOTA 95.79%；与 Top-K 选择相比，视觉多样性提升146%，时间覆盖率提升89%，信息可检索性提升3.5%。
AI.conclusion: 多目标跟踪与行人重识别融合，配合多因素关键帧选择与ANMS，可在复杂遮挡与低画质场景下同时实现高跟踪稳定性与高摘要多样性、时序覆盖和信息可检索性。

title: Metric-Bench: Exploring In-context Spatial Metric Reasoning in VLMs for Indoor Scenes
summary: Metric reasoning is a critical and challenging task for Vision Language Models (VLMs), playing a pivotal role in embodied AI tasks such as robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. However, current spatial reasoning remains bottlenecked by rigid pixel-level supervision; such localized optimization often compromises general multimodal intelligence, triggering performance degradation or catastrophic forgetting of broad reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce Metric-Bench, a focused benchmark designed to guide metric-spatial reasoning using contextual information. By incorporating in-image reference objects with known physical dimensions, Metric-Bench guides models to implicitly learn the 2D-to-3D mapping without camera intrinsics. We further present MetricReasoner, a task-adapted reinforcement fine-tuning recipe for reference-grounded metric reasoning, using structured prompts and verifiable numerical rewards. Extensive experiments on Metric-Bench demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances spatial metric understanding, outperforming existing and even larger proprietary models by 43.1\%, while improving downstream embodied performance over a spatial-specialized counterpart by 30.4\% on RoboSpatial overall accuracy and 9.3\% on ERQA, and additionally delivering consistent gains on general benchmarks (15.9\% on V$\star$Bench, 88.9\% on BLINK), indicating that the proposed adaptation does not necessarily compromise general VLM capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Metric-Bench基准与MetricReasoner微调方法，通过参考物体与可验证数值奖励实现无相机内参的度量空间推理，显著提升VLM空间度量理解与具身性能且不损害通用能力。
AI.motivation: 度量推理是VLM在具身AI中的关键任务，但现有空间推理依赖刚性的像素级监督，这种局部优化会损害多模态通用智能，导致性能下降或对广泛推理能力的灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 引入Metric-Bench基准，利用图像中已知物理尺寸的参考物体，引导模型在无相机内参条件下隐式学习2D到3D映射；并提出MetricReasoner，一种面向参考接地度量推理的任务适配强化微调方案，采用结构化提示与可验证数值奖励。
AI.result: 在Metric-Bench上，该方法较现有及更大规模专有模型提升43.1%；在RoboSpatial整体准确率提升30.4%，ERQA提升9.3%；通用基准上V⋆Bench提升15.9%，BLINK提升88.9%。
AI.conclusion: 基于参考物体的度量推理微调可显著增强空间度量理解与下游具身性能，同时并不必然牺牲VLM的通用能力，为度量空间推理提供了有效范式。

title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
summary: Many vision applications ask several independent, forced-choice questions about the same image. Visual Jev encodes the image and public context once, executes isolated question suffixes as a batch, and reads candidate probabilities from the backbone's language-model head. Across four benchmarks, answer-supervised post-training raises equal-weight macro accuracy from 70.6% to 76.1%, with the gain concentrated on the two task families represented in training. At N=32 questions per image, shared batched execution is 8.9x faster in warm amortized time than independent serial execution and remains 3.4x faster than an already-batched baseline that recomputes the prefix, at the cost of higher peak memory. A matched typed-head control offers no consistent accuracy advantage over the language-model-head readout. The supported design is therefore simple: adapt the backbone for quality, retain the existing readout, and share execution for efficiency.

AI.tldr: Visual Jev 对同一图像的多路独立强制选择题：共享图像与公共上下文的编码，把各问题后缀作为批处理执行，并从语言模型头读取候选概率。适配骨干网络时保留原读出、共享执行即得质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 视觉应用常需对同一图像提出多个相互独立的强制选择题，若逐题串行执行会造成重复计算、效率低下，因此需要一种共享计算、同时保证作答质量的设计。
AI.method: Visual Jev 将图像与公共上下文编码一次，把相互隔离的各问题后缀组合成批处理执行，候选答案概率直接取自骨干网络的语言模型头；并采用答案监督的后训练进行微调。同时设置类型化头（typed-head）作为匹配对照，与语言模型头读出进行对比。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，答案监督后训练把等权宏平均准确率从 70.6% 提升到 76.1%，增益集中在训练覆盖的两类任务上。每图 N=32 个问题时，共享批处理在热摊销时间上比独立串行快 8.9 倍，也比已批处理但需重算前缀的基线快 3.4 倍，代价是更高的峰值内存。匹配的类型化头对照相比语言模型头读出没有稳定优势。
AI.conclusion: 推荐的设计是简洁的：为质量而适配骨干网络，保留既有读出方式，并以共享执行换取效率。

title: Less Is More in the Long Tail: Stage-Adaptive Sample Selection for Annotation-Efficient Dense Prediction
summary: Deep learning performance generally improves with increasing training data, yet this scaling is fundamentally constrained by annotation cost in large-scale dense prediction tasks with long-tailed category distributions, where pixel- or voxel-level annotation is prohibitively expensive. We propose SASS (Stage-Adaptive Sample Selection), a stage-adaptive data-selection framework for pool-based active learning in long-tailed dense prediction. SASS combines three components: label-free self-supervised gradient scoring, prior-guided category rebalancing with validation-driven feedback, and stage-adaptive acquisition aligned with model training dynamics. This design avoids candidate ground-truth masks during gradient scoring while making acquisition responsive to long-tail imbalance and evolving representations. We evaluate SASS on a multimodal 3D medical segmentation testbed comprising over 100,000 samples spanning 108 anatomical structures. SASS recovers 98.3% of full-dataset performance with a 40% training-pool annotation budget, outperforming BADGE by 5.1 percentage points. Moreover, SASS exhibits a statistically supported less-is-more pattern, surpassing full-dataset training at the Hard-group level and, at the structure level, for the pancreas and gallbladder. More broadly, SASS shows that annotation-efficient learning depends not only on which samples are selected, but also on how the annotation budget is distributed across categories and when model-derived scores begin to guide selection.

AI.tldr: SASS 是一种面向长尾密集预测的阶段自适应主动学习样本选择框架，在10万+样本的三维医学分割任务上以40%标注预算恢复98.3%全量性能，并超越BADGE 5.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 深度学习方法性能通常随训练数据增加而提升，但在长尾类别分布的大规模密集预测任务中，像素/体素级标注成本极高，构成根本性瓶颈。因此需要在有限标注预算下实现高效的数据选择。
AI.method: 提出SASS（Stage-Adaptive Sample Selection）框架，用于池化式主动学习中的阶段自适应数据选择，包含三个组件：（1）无标签自监督梯度打分；（2）先验引导的类别重平衡，并引入验证集驱动反馈；（3）与模型训练动态相匹配的阶段自适应采集策略。该设计在梯度打分时无需候选样本的真实掩码，同时使采集策略能响应长尾不平衡与表征演化。
AI.result: 在多模态3D医学分割测试平台（超10万样本、108个解剖结构）上评估：SASS 以40%训练池标注预算恢复全数据集98.3%的性能，较BADGE高出5.1个百分点；呈现统计上支持的“少即是多”现象，在Hard组层面以及胰腺、胆囊结构层面超过全数据集训练。
AI.conclusion: 标注高效学习不仅取决于选择哪些样本，还取决于标注预算如何在类别间分配，以及模型衍生分数何时开始引导选择。

title: MemoryAthena: Adaptive Routing over Latent and Generated Memories
summary: Learned-memory methods store information in an explicit table and consume it through a separate reader, allowing addressing, storage, and reading to be modified independently. We study whether useful memory can also be generated rather than only retrieved. MemoryAthena uses three pathways: direct Engram retrieval (E), generation from retrieved Engram cues (GE), and generation from causal backbone states without consulting the memory table (GH). Generated memory is conditionally useful: it can complement E in one context but interfere with it in another. MemoryAthena therefore treats E as an anchor and learns when a generated representation should intervene. With the backbone, memory, generators, and readers frozen, a lightweight causal routing head is trained from counterfactual future-token likelihood advantages of GE and GH relative to E. At inference time, an admitted candidate modifies the E residual through bounded interpolation, while rejection recovers the direct pathway exactly. On question answering, MemoryAthena raises the five-task average from 37.65 to 39.28 over the direct pathway of the same checkpoint, while the six-task general-NLP average increases from 76.73 to 79.13. The complete memory-side system contains approximately 201M parameters, excluding the frozen backbone. Further analyses show complementary strengths among E, GE, and GH across tasks and inputs. These results support generated memory as a selective correction to direct retrieval and highlight routing when, which, and how strongly to intervene as the central challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出MemoryAthena：在学习型记忆系统中引入“生成式记忆”，通过因果路由头选择性干预直接检索，在QA和通用NLP任务上均带来一致提升。
AI.motivation: 传统学习型记忆方法把信息存入显式记忆表并通过独立reader读取，记忆的生成能力未被利用。作者探究：有用记忆能否被“生成”而非仅被“检索”，并解决生成记忆条件性有效（有时互补、有时干扰）的问题。
AI.method: 设计三条路径：直接Engram检索(E)、由检索到的Engram线索生成(GE)、不查阅记忆表而由因果骨干状态生成(GH)。冻结骨干、记忆表、生成器与reader，仅训练一个轻量因果路由头，依据GE、GH相对E的反事实未来token似然优势进行学习。推理时被接纳的候选通过有界插值修正E残差，被拒绝则精确恢复直接路径。
AI.result: 同一checkpoint下，问答五任务平均从37.65提升至39.28；六任务通用NLP平均从76.73提升至79.13。记忆侧完整系统约201M参数（不含冻结骨干）。分析显示E、GE、GH在不同任务与输入上具有互补优势。
AI.conclusion: 生成式记忆可作为直接检索的选择性修正，核心挑战在于路由“何时、选择哪个、以多强程度”进行干预。

title: BELXTR: Biomedical Entity Linking via Contextualized Token Retrieval
summary: Biomedical Entity Linking disambiguates mentions to entities in a knowledge base (KB), making it the cornerstone of information extraction pipelines. While embedding-based models are a popular approach for the task, they suffer from a key limitation. They compress mentions (and entities) into a single vector, forcing the model to average away crucial fine-grained differences. We present BELXTR, a novel embedding model based on the multi-vector (a.k.a. late interaction) architecture, which allows to leverage token-level matching information. BELXTR extends the original XTR model to biomedical entity linking by integrating an existing task-specific training objective and exploring active query expansion. Experiments across ten corpora and five KBs show that BELXTR improves upon current state-of-the-art in half of the corpora with an average improvement of 5pp recall@1. The largest gains are reported on the challenging cross-species gene disambiguation subtask, where BELXTR outperforms an LLM-powered retrieve-and-rerank pipeline and closely approaches a specialized rule-based system. Our results highlight multi-vector models as a practical alternative to hard-to-maintain rule-based systems or in scenarios where LLM-based reranking is too costly as in PubMed-scale mining. The code to reproduce our experiments can be found at: https://github.com/sg-wbi/belxtr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BELXTR，一种基于多向量（late interaction）架构的生物医学实体链接嵌入模型，通过引入任务特定训练目标与主动查询扩展，在十个语料与五个知识库上平均提升 5pp recall@1。
AI.motivation: 传统基于嵌入的生物医学实体链接模型将提及和实体压缩为单一向量，被迫抹平关键的细粒度差异，导致无法充分利用词元级匹配信息。
AI.method: BELXTR 将原 XTR 模型扩展至生物医学实体链接，采用多向量（late interaction）架构以利用词元级匹配信息，整合现有任务特定的训练目标，并探索主动查询扩展（active query expansion）。
AI.result: 在十个语料和五个知识库上的实验显示，BELXTR 在一半语料上超越当前最优方法，平均提升 5pp recall@1；在跨物种基因消歧子任务上提升最大，超越 LLM 驱动的检索-重排流程，并接近专用规则系统。
AI.conclusion: 多向量模型可作为难以维护的规则系统或 LLM 重排成本过高场景（如 PubMed 规模挖掘）的实用替代方案。

title: High-Capacity Robust Medical Image Exfiltration via Neural Network Weight Replacement
summary: Collaborative medical AI platforms allow researchers to train models on sensitive imaging data while restricting data export. However, trained models can serve as covert carriers of patient information: medical images may be encoded within model parameters and reconstructed outside the secure environment. Existing defenses rely on lightweight sanitization (e.g., fine-tuning, pruning, quantization) and limited statistical auditing, creating a realistic insider exfiltration risk. We introduce a high-capacity neural steganography attack that encodes medical images as continuous latent representations embedded into model initialization. A StyleGAN2-based adversarial autoencoder learns compact latent codes regularized to match standard weight initialization statistics, keeping embedded parameters statistically consistent with clean models. Noise injection during training improves robustness to export-time mitigation. The carrier model remains functional on its intended task and hidden images can be reconstructed directly from its weights after export. This continuous encoding enables robust and scalable exfiltration, allowing up to 99 brain MRI volumes to be embedded within a 30MB model, and remains recoverable under mitigations that disrupt prior bit-level schemes. While reconstructions are approximate rather than pixel-exact, embedded content remains anatomically recognizable and recoverable at scale, exposing a privacy risk distinct from prior bit-level approaches. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, BraTS, and LiTS demonstrate effectiveness across modalities, tasks, and architectures, highlighting the need for structural defenses beyond parameter-level sanitization. Code is available at https://github.com/ElieThellier/high-capacity-robust-medical-image-exfiltration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种高容量神经隐写攻击，将医学图像编码为连续隐表示并嵌入模型初始化权重中，可在协作医学AI平台导出后重构敏感影像，绕过现有轻量级消毒与统计审计。
AI.motivation: 协作医学AI平台虽限制数据导出，但训练好的模型可充当患者信息的隐蔽载体——图像可被编码进模型参数并在安全环境外重构。现有防御依赖轻量级消毒（微调、剪枝、量化）和有限统计审计，存在现实的内部人员窃取风险。
AI.method: 提出高容量神经隐写攻击：基于StyleGAN2的对抗自编码器学习紧凑隐码，并将其正则化以匹配标准权重初始化统计分布，使嵌入参数的统计特征与干净模型一致；训练时加噪增强对导出时缓解措施的鲁棒性；载体模型仍可完成目标任务，隐藏图像可直接从其权重重构。
AI.result: 连续编码实现鲁棒且可扩展的窃取：30MB模型内可嵌入多达99个脑MRI体数据；在破坏先前比特级方案的缓解措施下仍可恢复。重构虽为近似而非像素级精确，但嵌入内容在解剖学上可识别且可大规模恢复；在MIMIC-CXR、BraTS、LiTS上验证了跨模态、任务与架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作暴露了一种不同于以往比特级方法的隐私风险，表明仅靠参数级消毒不足以防御此类连续隐写窃取，凸显了需要结构性防御的必要性。

title: MatchFusion: Explicit-Implicit Instance Matching for Spatio-Temporal Multimodal Autonomous Driving
summary: Sparse instance representations provide a compact interface for spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction in multimodal perception and E2EAD. Effective interaction requires reliable instance correspondences despite geometric discrepancies and heterogeneous semantic representations. Attention-based methods exploit contextual semantics but often require specialized representation alignment, increasing computational overhead. In contrast, association based on structured object states is efficient and interpretable but lacks contextual evidence to resolve ambiguous matches. To combine these complementary strengths, we propose MatchFusion, a learnable instance matching and fusion module for spatio-temporal multimodal autonomous driving. MatchFusion initializes pairwise affinities using geometric similarity and category consistency, then selectively refines structurally plausible associations using instance embeddings. The resulting soft matchmap guides a common residual aggregation operator for adaptive information exchange. This unified matching-fusion formulation supports spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction, using multi-view image-plane geometry and motion-compensated BEV geometry as the respective structural priors. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate consistent perception gains across diverse front-end configurations. Compared with a prior instance-centric fusion method, the MatchFusion-equipped system achieves higher perception accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55.3% and GPU memory usage by 39.3%, with the matching-fusion module accounting for only 3.7% of total perception latency. Integrating temporal MatchFusion into SparseDrive further improves perception within an E2E framework without additional supervision. These results establish explicit-implicit matching as an effective and efficient mechanism for spatio-temporal instance interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出MatchFusion，一种可学习的实例匹配与融合模块，通过几何相似度与类别一致性初始化亲和度，再用实例嵌入选择性细化，实现空间LiDAR-相机与时间过去-当前的高效交互。
AI.motivation: 稀疏实例表征为多模态感知与端到端自动驾驶中的空间LiDAR-相机及时间过去-当前交互提供了紧凑接口。但有效交互需在几何差异和异构语义表征下建立可靠实例对应：基于注意力的方法利用上下文语义但需专门表征对齐，计算开销大；基于结构化物体状态的方法高效可解释，却缺乏上下文证据来解决模糊匹配。
AI.method: MatchFusion首先利用几何相似度和类别一致性初始化成对亲和度，随后使用实例嵌入对结构上合理的关联进行选择性细化。生成的软匹配图指导一个通用残差聚合算子，实现自适应信息交换。该统一的匹配-融合公式分别以多视角图像平面几何和运动补偿BEV几何作为结构先验，支持空间与时间交互。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，不同前端配置均获得一致的感知增益。相比先前的实例中心融合方法，配备MatchFusion的系统感知精度更高，同时FLOPs降低55.3%、GPU内存降低39.3%，匹配-融合模块仅占总感知延迟的3.7%。将时间MatchFusion集成到SparseDrive后，在不增加额外监督的情况下进一步提升了端到端框架内的感知性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，显式-隐式匹配是一种有效且高效的时空实例交互机制。

title: Isolated Sign Language Recognition for Icelandic Sign Language: Experiments in a Low-resource Setting
summary: We present the first experiments on isolated sign language recognition (ISLR) for Icelandic Sign Language (ÍTM). We use ÍTM SignWiki, a dataset derived from a bilingual Icelandic--ÍTM online dictionary. It is genuinely low-resource: 1,845 videos cover 849 classes, 86% of which have only two examples, making the full task effectively one-shot recognition across signers. We compare two open-source ISLR frameworks, OpenHands and SPOTER, on three tasks of increasing vocabulary size (22, 117 and 849 classes), and evaluate three pose estimators and two forms of cross-lingual transfer. With ÍTM data alone, SPOTER outperforms OpenHands on all three tasks, and MediaPipe poses give better results than AlphaPose or SDPose. Cross-lingual transfer brings the largest gains: pretraining SPOTER on American Sign Language data before finetuning on ÍTM raises accuracy by 14--24 percentage points, to 72.7%, 47.9% and 22.6% on the three tasks, and multilingual training with data from six other sign languages lifts OpenHands from 1.41% to 28.86% on the full task. Although far from practical use, the results suggest that transfer from better-resourced sign languages is promising for very low-resource ones. We release our adapted versions of both frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文首次开展冰岛手语（ÍTM）孤立手语识别（ISLR）研究，基于低资源词 SignWiki，对比 OpenHands 与 SPOTER 两种框架，发现跨语言迁移带来最大性能提升。
AI.motivation: 冰岛手语属于真正低资源语言，现有 ISLR 研究多集中于高资源手语，缺乏对 ÍTM 的实验与跨语言迁移可行性的验证。
AI.method: 使用 ÍTM SignWiki 数据集（1,845 视频、849 类，86% 类仅两例，近似 one-shot），在 22/117/849 三类任务上对比 OpenHands 与 SPOTER，评估三种姿态估计器（MediaPipe、AlphaPose、SDPose）及两种跨语言迁移（ASL 预训练微调、六种手语多语言训练）。
AI.result: 仅用 ÍTM 数据时 SPOTER 全面优于 OpenHands，MediaPipe 姿态效果最佳；ASL 预训练后微调使 SPOTER 准确率提升 14–24 个百分点，达 72.7%、47.9%、22.6%；六语多语言训练将 OpenHands 在完整任务上从 1.41% 提升至 28.86%。
AI.conclusion: 尽管距实用尚有差距，结果表明从资源丰富手语向极低资源手语迁移具有前景，作者开源了两个框架的适配版本。

title: TV-AudioRemover: Joint Text-Visual Guided Sound Removal with Multi-Task Hard-Mixture Curriculum
summary: Visual object removal can eliminate a target from video frames, yet its acoustic trace persists in the soundtrack, causing obvious audio-visual inconsistency. Existing video inpainting models operate solely on pixels, while audio editing models, especially for the sound removal task, are typically driven by text and therefore rely on limited single-modal control, which is less effective than multimodal guidance that provides stronger semantic grounding and temporal synchronization cues. In this paper, we present Text-Visual Guided Sound Removal (TV-AudioRemover), a target sound removal framework that leverages the visually edited video together with a natural-language instruction to suppress the sound associated with the removed visual object from the original audio mixture. To acquire high-quality training data, we devise a pipeline to construct a million-scale dataset of single-object audio-visual aligned samples, from which we synthesize mixture-target pairs customized for model training. To effectively leverage visual context and follow instruction intent, we augment the model architecture with task tokens, generalizable instruction modeling, and modality-specific global guidance. We further adopt multi-task training to strengthen task-role comprehension, and employ a hard-mixture curriculum that leverages semantically similar acoustic mixtures during fine-tuning to enhance fine-grained source discrimination. To support evaluation, we present AV-Remove-Bench, a comprehensive audio-visual object removal benchmark, along with dedicated objective metrics and an MLLM-based evaluation protocol. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both subjective and objective metrics. Project page: https://yjx-research.github.io/TV-AudioRemover/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TV-AudioRemover 框架，利用视觉编辑后视频与自然语言指令，从原始音频混合中移除被删除物体对应的声音，并构建百万级数据集、AV-Remove-Bench 评测基准及 MLLM 评测协议，取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉物体移除后其声学痕迹仍残留于音轨，造成明显的视听不一致；现有视频修复模型仅处理像素，音频编辑（声音移除）模型多由文本驱动，仅依赖单模态控制，缺乏多模态引导带来的更强语义锚定与时序同步线索。
AI.method: 提出 Text-Visual Guided Sound Removal（TV-AudioRemover）框架，以视觉编辑后的视频结合自然语言指令作为引导。构建流水线生成百万级单物体视听对齐数据集，并合成混合-目标配对的训练数据。模型架构引入任务 token、可泛化指令建模与模态特定全局引导；采用多任务训练强化任务角色理解，并在微调阶段使用语义相似声学混合的硬混合课程学习以增强细粒度声源判别。
AI.result: 在主观和客观指标上均达到最先进性能；同时发布 AV-Remove-Bench 综合视听物体移除基准，配套客观指标与基于 MLLM 的评测协议。
AI.conclusion: 多模态（文本-视觉）引导的目标声音移除优于单模态控制，配合大规模数据集、专门架构设计与课程学习策略，可有效解决视听物体移除后的声学残留与一致性问题，并推动该方向标准化评测。

title: Delving into Asymmetric Information Dynamics for High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On
summary: Virtual try-on (VTON) requires precise pixel-level fidelity, yet mainstream Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) often suffer from texture degradation and structural drift. We identify symmetric interactions in standard joint-attention mechanisms as a source of these failures. Although such interactions support semantic flexibility in general-purpose editing, they allow stochastic noise to corrupt deterministic garment features in VTON. We analyze this problem through asymmetric information dynamics and introduce two diagnostic indicators: Conditional Attention Entropy (CAE) for feature unbiasedness and Injected Information Flux (IIF) for injection effectiveness. Our analysis suggests that symmetric bidirectional attention can corrupt conditional features and attenuate the conditional signal. To address these limitations, we propose RealFit, a framework that combines Unidirectional Information Flow (UIF) with Decoupled Timestep Modulation (DTM). UIF isolates the garment condition from stochastic noise to preserve garment identity, while DTM optimizes the modulation scale to maintain a strong conditional signal. The resulting time-invariant condition branch enables a conditional KV cache that reduces inference time by approximately 75%. RealFit offers a principled approach to conditional generation with state-of-the-art fidelity and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文针对虚拟试穿中DiT模型的纹理退化与结构漂移问题，指出标准联合注意力中的对称交互是失效根源，并提出RealFit框架以提升保真度与效率。
AI.motivation: 虚拟试穿（VTON）需要精确的像素级保真度，但主流Diffusion Transformers（DiTs）常出现纹理退化和结构漂移。作者识别出标准联合注意力机制中的对称交互是这些失效的来源：虽然对称交互在通用编辑中有助于语义灵活性，但在VTON中会使随机噪声污染确定性的服装特征。
AI.method: 作者通过非对称信息动态分析该问题，引入两个诊断指标：条件注意力熵（CAE）用于衡量特征无偏性，注入信息通量（IIF）用于衡量注入有效性。分析表明对称双向注意力会污染条件特征并削弱条件信号。据此提出RealFit框架，结合单向信息流（UIF）与解耦时间步调制（DTM）：UIF将服装条件与随机噪声隔离以保持服装身份，DTM优化调制尺度以维持强条件信号；由此得到的时不变条件分支支持条件KV缓存。
AI.result: 所得到的时不变条件分支实现了条件KV缓存，将推理时间减少约75%，并在保真度与效率上达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: RealFit为条件生成提供了一种有原则的方法，在虚拟试穿任务中同时实现了最先进的保真度与效率。

title: LoRango: It Takes Two LoRAs to Unlock Hidden Behaviors in Diffusion Models
summary: Users commonly combine multiple Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters to personalize images with different subjects, styles, and visual attributes. Yet inspecting adapters individually does not establish the safety of their composition. We identify and characterize a pair-conditioned attack in text-to-image diffusion: individually useful and benign-appearing adapters redirect image generation when co-loaded with a specifically matched partner, whose identity serves as the trigger. We introduce LoRango to realize this attack through complementary Signature and Payload adapters. The Signature writes a pair-specific code into intermediate carrier representations, while the Payload uses code-selective responses and opposing signal/reference branches. These branches approximately cancel for standalone adapters and mismatched pairs; matched code-reader alignment breaks cancellation within native GEGLU blocks and releases the programmed action. Both adapters are exported as ordinary static LoRA files compatible with standard loaders, requiring no prompt trigger or base-pipeline modification. LoRango achieves matched-pair attack success rates of 97.9\% on SD v1.5 and 98.7\% on SDXL, compared with 2.8--4.6\% when implanted adapters are loaded individually. Further experiments evaluate pair selectivity, standalone fidelity, robustness to deployment variations, and applicability across denoiser architectures. These findings show that individual-adapter inspection is insufficient to assess the security of multi-LoRA personalization and motivate auditing adapter compositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LoRango，一种针对多 LoRA 组合场景的"对条件"（pair-conditioned）攻击：单个良性 LoRA 适配器在与特定配对伙伴共同加载时才触发恶意行为，其身份即为触发器。攻击通过 Signature/Payload 两个互补适配器实现，在 SD v1.5 和 SDXL 上匹配对攻击成功率分别达 97.9% 和 98.7%，而单独加载时仅 2.8–4.6%。
AI.motivation: 用户常将多个 LoRA 适配器组合以个性化图像的主体、风格和视觉属性。然而，单独审查每个适配器无法保证其组合后的安全性。作者据此识别并刻画了文本到图像扩散模型中的"对条件攻击"：单个看似有用且良性的适配器，在与特定匹配伙伴共同加载时会改变图像生成结果，且伙伴身份充当触发器。这一威胁凸显了多 LoRA 个性化中组合级安全审计的必要性。
AI.method: 提出 LoRango，通过对条件攻击实现上述威胁，由互补的 Signature（签名）与 Payload（载荷）适配器构成。Signature 向中间载体表示写入对特定代码；Payload 利用代码选择性响应及相反的信号/参考分支。独立适配器和不匹配对中，两支路近似抵消；匹配的代码读取器对齐后，抵消在原生 GEGLU 块内被打破，从而释放预设动作。两个适配器均导出为普通静态 LoRA 文件，兼容标准加载器，无需提示触发或修改基础流水线。
AI.result: LoRango 在 SD v1.5 上匹配对攻击成功率达 97.9%，在 SDXL 上达 98.7%；相比之下，单独加载植入适配器时仅为 2.8–4.6%。进一步实验评估了对选择性、独立保真度、对部署变化的鲁棒性以及跨去噪器架构的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，仅检查单个适配器不足以评估多 LoRA 个性化的安全性，需推动对适配器组合进行安全审计。

title: Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling
summary: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI. It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个自动化语音分析系统，结合WhisperX语音识别与Silero语音活动检测及精细化时间戳，用于估计运动神经元病(MND)患者的言语流畅性指数(VFI)，以辅助认知障碍评估。
AI.motivation: MND患者常伴有言语障碍，导致认知障碍(CI)监测困难。ECAS量表是可靠的CI评估工具，其中VFI是核心指标，但人工评估受限，亟需自动化方法。
AI.method: 基于独特的MND数据集，整合ASR(WhisperX)与VAD(Silero)并进行精细化时间戳处理，提取多项临床可解释特征，采用多种回归算法预测VFI，并与传统声学特征及自监督嵌入方法进行对比。
AI.result: 所提系统优于基于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入的系统；临床启发式特征持续表现最佳，最优模型P-words达R² 0.9、NRMSE 0.05，S-words达R² 0.8、NRMSE 0.08。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了自动化VFI估计的可行性，为MND患者认知障碍的客观、可扩展监测提供了新途径。

title: Rethinking Length-Based Training: Batch Composition and Loss Normalization in Speech Token Language Models
summary: Short-to-long training is a simple curriculum for speech models, but its gains can be difficult to interpret. In speech token language models, length-based training can change the shuffle policy, batch composition, token retention, and token weights under batch-mean loss. We disentangle these factors through matched comparisons. In the tested settings, short-to-long ordering shows no independent benefit when batch composition and token exposure are fixed. First-epoch grouping lowers perplexity for Mimi under batch-mean loss, but this gain is not observed under token-balanced loss. The cross-tokenizer results are consistent with a link between chunk-length variation and token weighting. This work provides a systematic analysis protocol for studying length-based training in variable-length speech models.

AI.tldr: 短到长课程训练对语音模型的增益主要来自批组成与token加权等因素，而非长度排序本身；在固定批组成与token暴露量时，短到长排序无独立收益。
AI.motivation: 短到长训练是语音模型的简单课程策略，但其增益来源难以解释。在语音token语言模型中，基于长度的训练会同时改变shuffle策略、批组成、token保留和批均值损失下的token权重，这些因素相互纠缠，导致无法判断真正的收益来源。
AI.method: 通过匹配对照（matched comparisons）解耦上述因素，分别控制批组成与token暴露量，比较短到长排序的独立作用；并在不同损失函数（批均值损失与token平衡损失）及不同分词器（如Mimi）下进行一致性与跨分词器验证。
AI.result: 在测试设置中，当批组成与token暴露量固定时，短到长排序没有独立收益。首个epoch分组在批均值损失下降低了Mimi的困惑度，但在token平衡损失下未观察到该增益。跨分词器结果与"块长度变化和token加权之间存在关联"这一假设一致。
AI.conclusion: 短到长训练的表面增益多源于批组成与token加权等混杂因素，而非长度排序本身；本研究提供了一个系统分析协议，用于研究变长语音模型中基于长度的训练。

title: BAS-OPD: Budget-Aware Selective On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle with fine-grained visual perception when processing complete images, as critical evidence may only appear in local regions. On-policy self-distillation (OPD) enables transferring privileged visual knowledge from informative views to full-image policies, but querying the teacher for every rollout introduces substantial supervision costs. In this work, we propose BAS-OPD, a budget-aware selective OPD framework that allocates teacher supervision under limited query budgets. Instead of querying all rollouts, BAS-OPD selects informative samples while maintaining full-batch student generation. We explore random, uncertainty-based, and learned utility-based selection strategies, where the learned selector estimates query value from detached rollout statistics and online utility signals derived from student--teacher agreement and teacher confidence without additional student forward passes. BAS-OPD only changes training-time supervision allocation and preserves single-pass full-image inference. Experiments on fine-grained multimodal perception benchmarks demonstrate that BAS-OPD achieves strong performance while substantially reducing teacher supervision costs, highlighting the effectiveness of selective OPD under constrained budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BAS-OPD，一种预算感知的选择性在线策略自蒸馏框架，在有限查询预算下为 MLLM 分配教师监督，仅选择信息量高的样本进行蒸馏，同时保持全批量学生生成与单次全图推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型处理完整图像时对细粒度视觉感知能力不足，关键证据往往只存在于局部区域。在线策略自蒸馏可将有信息量视图中的特权视觉知识迁移到全图策略，但为每次 rollout 查询教师会带来高昂的监督成本。因此需要研究如何在有限查询预算下选择性地分配教师监督。
AI.method: 提出 BAS-OPD 预算感知的选择性 OPD 框架：不做全量 rollout 查询，而是保持全批量学生生成的同时筛选信息量大的样本。探索了随机选择、基于不确定性的选择和基于学习效用（learned utility）的选择三种策略；学习型选择器利用脱离梯度的 rollout 统计量以及由学生-教师一致性和教师置信度导出的在线效用信号来估计查询价值，无需额外的学生前向计算。该方法只改变训练时的监督分配，保留单次全图推理。
AI.result: 在细粒度多模态感知基准上的实验表明，BAS-OPD 在取得较强性能的同时大幅降低了教师监督成本，验证了受限预算下选择性 OPD 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在有限查询预算下进行选择性在线策略自蒸馏，可在显著削减教师监督开销的同时保持甚至提升细粒度多模态感知性能，且不改变推理时的单次全图流程，为高效 OPD 提供了可行路径。

title: The Ongiini-Eval-OW Benchmark: A Concept Paper for the Planned Benchmarking of Machine Translation and Large Language Models on Oshindonga and Oshikwanyama
comment: 14 pages, 6 tables. Concept paper for a planned benchmark; first public dataset release targeted for Q4 2026. Dataset CC-BY-4.0, code MIT
summary: Oshiwambo -- a cluster of mutually intelligible Bantu languages spoken by over a million people across northern Namibia and southern Angola, and the home language of roughly half of Namibian households -- has, to our knowledge, no published machine-translation evaluation benchmark. Major commercial services (Google Translate, DeepL, Microsoft Translator), open multilingual MT models (NLLB-200, MADLAD-400), and the open Masakhane checkpoint collection all lack coverage of either standardised dialect, Oshindonga or Oshikwanyama. We announce Ongiini-Eval-OW, a planned 600-item English-Oshindonga and English-Oshikwanyama benchmark with native-speaker references from two independent translators, a 30-item inter-translator agreement set, an 11-tag phenomenon-tagged stratification (at least 30 items per tag), a deterministic 30% blind split, and a reproducible scoring protocol over chrF++, BLEU, and COMET-22, supplemented by a 50-item human-evaluation round. We document the empirical coverage gap, the dataset composition, the launch-leaderboard model matrix across American, European, and Chinese frontier and open-weight systems, and the contribution pipeline. The dataset is targeted for first public release in Q4 2026; this v1.0 concept paper announces the design and the call for participation. Data and code will be released under CC-BY-4.0 and MIT respectively.

AI.tldr: 该概念论文宣布构建Ongiini-Eval-OW，首个面向奥万博语（Oshindonga与Oshikwanyama）的英-奥机器翻译评测基准，计划2026年Q4首发。
AI.motivation: 奥万博语是纳米比亚北部与安哥拉南部逾百万人使用的班图语簇，约半数纳米比亚家庭以其为母语，但据作者所知尚无已发布的机器翻译评测基准；Google Translate、DeepL、微软翻译等商业服务，NLLB-200、MADLAD-400等开放多语模型，以及Masakhane检查点集合均未覆盖Oshindonga或Oshikwanyama两种标准化方言，存在显著的经验性覆盖缺口。
AI.method: 构建Ongiini-Eval-OW基准：600条英-Oshindonga与英-Oshikwanyama条目，由两名独立译者提供母语者参考译文；设30条译者间一致性集合；采用11标签现象分层（每标签至少30条）；确定性30%盲划分；在chrF++、BLEU与COMET-22上执行可复现评分协议；另设50条人工评测。论文同时记录覆盖缺口、数据集构成、横跨美欧中前沿与开放权重系统的启动排行榜模型矩阵及贡献流程。
AI.result: 论文报告了现有商业、开放多语与Masakhane资源对两种方言的经验性覆盖缺口，并给出数据集组成、启动排行榜模型矩阵及贡献管线的设计说明。数据集计划于2026年Q4首次公开发布，数据与代码分别以CC-BY-4.0和MIT许可发布。
AI.conclusion: 作为v1.0概念论文，本文发布基准设计并发出参与号召，旨在填补奥万博语机器翻译评测空白，为低资源班图语言的翻译系统提供可复现、可扩展的评测基础设施。

title: NaCR: Visual Localization via NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression
summary: Visual localization (VL) is a fundamental technology for vision applications such as virtual reality. Recently, a novel VL paradigm, Camera Ray Regression (CRR), has emerged, which maps 2D image patches to 3D camera rays, but its accuracy is limited. To improve CRR accuracy, we notice a compelling duality: the inverse of this mapping is inherently performed by the novel view synthesis model, \ie, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). While NeRF renders image patches from camera rays via differentiable ray marching, CRR predicts the rays from image patches. Motivated by this complementary relationship, we propose NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression (NaCR), a unified framework that seamlessly bridges NeRF and CRR at the ray level. First, NaCR incorporates three simple yet effective enhancements into the CRR baseline. Second, leveraging a pre-trained NeRF, NaCR augments the training data by synthesizing novel views tailored for efficient, patch-level consumption. Finally, exploiting the differentiability of NeRF, NaCR forms a closed-loop supervision pipeline where photometric rendering errors are back-propagated to optimize the predicted camera rays. To ensure stable convergence within the highly non-convex image space, we introduce a two-stage training curriculum. Extensive experiments across indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that NaCR achieves competitive accuracy. Comprehensive ablation studies validate the efficacy of each proposed component.

AI.tldr: 提出NaCR框架，将NeRF与相机射线回归(CRR)在射线层面统一，通过增强基线、NeRF合成新视角数据增强、渲染误差闭环监督及两阶段训练课程提升视觉定位精度。
AI.motivation: 视觉定位中的相机射线回归(CRR)将2D图像块映射为3D相机射线，但其精度有限。作者注意到CRR的逆映射正是NeRF所执行的novel view synthesis，二者存在互补对偶关系，因此希望借助NeRF提升CRR精度。
AI.method: NaCR统一框架：(1)在CRR基线上引入三项简单有效的增强；(2)利用预训练NeRF合成新视角，进行适配高效patch级消耗的数据增强；(3)利用NeRF可微性构建闭环监督，将光度渲染误差反传以优化预测相机射线；(4)引入两阶段训练课程以保证在高度非凸图像空间中稳定收敛。
AI.result: 在室内与室外基准上的大量实验表明NaCR达到具有竞争力的精度，消融实验验证了各提出组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过射线层面桥接NeRF与CRR，并在数据增强与闭环监督下优化，NaCR有效提升了相机射线回归的视觉定位精度。

title: Informed Masking: Structure-Aware Perturbation for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as an efficient alternative to autoregressive models, yet aligning them via Reinforcement Learning (RL) requires likelihood surrogates estimated from masked reconstruction subproblems under a small Monte Carlo budget per rollout. Existing methods construct these subproblems by uniform random masking, leaving open the question of which subproblems to prioritize. We identify a systematic upstream/downstream structure in dLLM rollouts. Some tokens, when revealed, trigger large confidence changes in nearby undecoded positions; we call them upstream. Others induce only small local changes and are therefore downstream. We find masking downstream tokens yields substantially better-posed subproblems than masking upstream tokens, a phenomenon we term subproblem difficulty asymmetry. Based on the observation, we propose Informed Masking (IM), which derives a per-token priority score from the denoising trajectory at zero extra inference cost and biases mask sampling toward downstream tokens. IM is plug-and-play: when plugged into three state-of-the-art dLLM RL methods on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, it delivers up to 2.01%, 8.68%, and 5.77% relative average gains on math and planning benchmarks with improved training stability.

AI.tldr: 本文发现扩散大语言模型（dLLM）强化学习中的掩码重构子问题存在"上游/下游"结构，掩码下游token能构造更良定的子问题，据此提出无需额外推理开销的 Informed Masking（IM）方法，即插即用地提升多种SOTA方法的性能与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: dLLM作为自回归模型的高效替代，其RL对齐依赖从小规模蒙特卡洛预算下的掩码重构子问题估计似然代理。现有方法均采用均匀随机掩码构造子问题，忽略了"应优先选择哪些子问题"这一关键问题。
AI.method: 作者识别出dLLM rollout中存在系统性的上游/下游结构：上游token被揭示时会引发邻近未解码位置的显著置信度变化，下游token仅造成微小局部变化。实验发现掩码下游token构成的子问题比掩码上游token更良定，称之为"子问题难度不对称"。基于此提出Informed Masking（IM），从去噪轨迹中以零额外推理成本导出逐token优先级分数，使掩码采样偏向于下游token。IM为即插即用模块。
AI.result: 将IM分别插入三种SOTA的dLLM RL方法，在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上，于数学与规划基准上取得最高2.01%、8.68%和5.77%的相对平均性能提升，同时训练稳定性改善。
AI.conclusion: 掩码子问题的选择对dLLM的RL对齐质量至关重要；偏向下游token的IM是一种零开销、通用的改进策略，可有效提升多种现有方法的表现。

title: AT3D-AD: Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection via Hierarchical Point-Language Alignment
summary: Detecting and localizing 3D point-cloud defects is essential for industrial inspection. However, existing methods often suffer from imprecise localization due to the lack of anomaly supervision and reliance on single-granularity representations. To address these limitations, we propose Anomaly Type-Aware 3D Anomaly Detection (AT3D-AD), a unified framework for joint detection, localization, and classification. Specifically, we first design the Physics-Driven Parametric Anomaly Synthesis (PDPAS) module employing multiple parametric functions to generate synthetic anomalies, providing explicit anomaly supervision. Then, we propose the Hierarchical Global-Local Anomaly Alignment (HiGLA) module to align global and local representations within the normal and anomalous groups. Finally, we propose the Semantic-Geometric Anomaly Classification (SGAC) module to jointly learn localization and classification, yielding spatially precise and type-discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments establish new state-of-the-art performance on all four benchmarks. AT3D-AD achieves Object/Point AUROC scores of 98.1\%/98.9\% on Anomaly-ShapeNet and 95.0\%/95.2\% on Real3D-AD, while reaching 74.2\% Macro-F1 for anomaly-type recognition on Real3D-AD.

AI.tldr: 提出AT3D-AD统一框架，联合实现3D点云异常的检测、定位与分类，并利用物理驱动合成异常与层次化对齐提升定位精度，在四个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D点云缺陷检测方法因缺乏异常监督信号、且依赖单一粒度表征，导致定位不精确，难以满足工业检测需求。
AI.method: 框架包含三个模块：1）PDPAS（Physics-Driven Parametric Anomaly Synthesis），用多种参数化函数生成合成异常，提供显式异常监督；2）HiGLA（Hierarchical Global-Local Anomaly Alignment），在正常与异常组内对齐全局和局部表征；3）SGAC（Semantic-Geometric Anomaly Classification），联合学习定位与分类，生成空间精确且类型可区分的异常表征。
AI.result: 在全部四个基准上取得新的SOTA。Anomaly-ShapeNet上Object/Point AUROC为98.1%/98.9%；Real3D-AD上为95.0%/95.2%，异常类型识别Macro-F1达74.2%。
AI.conclusion: AT3D-AD通过显式异常监督与多粒度全局-局部对齐，统一了3D异常的检测、定位与分类，显著提升了工业点云检测的定位精度与类型判别能力。

title: Calibrating Retrieval Geometry: Reliability-Guided Training-Free Aggregation for Visual Place Recognition
summary: Frozen visual foundation models provide transferable features for visual place recognition, but fixed aggregation can suppress useful distinctions in new environments. We introduce TFA, a reliability-guided, training-free aggregation method requiring neither place labels nor task-specific weight updates. Our key observation is that reproducible retrieval need not be discriminative: independent codebooks can consistently retrieve a few database hubs. TFA combines cross-codebook agreement, retrieval coverage, and spectral statistics to control residual assignment, spectral shaping, and global-feature fusion. Its spectral kernel exactly recovers original descriptor similarity at zero intervention. Database-only TFA fixes its rules before accessing queries; TFA-C64 uses 64 disjoint unlabeled target images to calibrate retrieval for subsequent queries. Across 20 ground protocols with a fixed DINOv2-B backbone and matched resolution, database-only TFA improves Recall@1 over AnyLoc by 17.39 percentage points on MSLS-val and 9.55 on SPED. C64 mitigates failures of database-only calibration in driving environments. Across eight aerial/cross-view protocols, TFA achieves the highest Recall@1 among compared training-free heads in 14 of 16 DINOv2/DINOv3 backbone-protocol combinations. In a separate native-system comparison, DINOv2-G-based TFA-C64 reaches 91.46% Recall@1 on Pitts30k and 76.29% on VPAIR, outperforming the displayed training-free comparators on all five benchmarks. These results show that reliability-guided aggregation can recover additional retrieval capability from frozen representations, providing a practical baseline for new environments with scarce place supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TFA，一种可靠性引导、免训练的聚合方法，用于从冻结视觉基础模型中挖掘可迁移的位置识别特征，无需地点标签或权重更新。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉基础模型虽提供可迁移特征，但固定聚合方式会抑制新环境中有用的判别性信息；且新环境往往缺乏地点监督，难以进行任务特定的权重微调。
AI.method: 关键观察是"可复现检索不必判别性"：独立码本可稳定检索到少量数据库枢纽。TFA 结合跨码本一致性、检索覆盖率与谱统计量，控制残差分配、谱整形与全局特征融合；其谱核在零干预时精确还原原始描述子相似度。包含两种变体：database-only TFA（在接触查询前固定规则）与 TFA-C64（用 64 张不重叠的无标签目标图像校准检索）。
AI.result: 在固定 DINOv2-B 骨干与匹配分辨率下，20 个地面协议中 database-only TFA 相对 AnyLoc 在 MSLS-val 上 Recall@1 提升 17.39 个百分点、SPED 上提升 9.55；C64 缓解驾驶环境下 database-only 校准的失败。8 个航空/跨视角协议中，16 个 DINOv2/DINOv3 骨干-协议组合中 14 个取得最高 Recall@1。原生系统比较中，基于 DINOv2-G 的 TFA-C64 在 Pitts30k 达 91.46%、VPAIR 达 76.29%，在全部五个基准上优于所展示的免训练对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性引导的聚合能够从冻结表征中恢复额外检索能力，为地点监督稀缺的新环境提供实用基线。

title: Certified Against Which Oracle? Execution Labels Set the Reported Risk of Conformal Abstention for Text-to-SQL
summary: A conformal abstention certificate for text-to-SQL is only as truthful as the correctness labels it is calibrated on. The uncertainty pipelines that read confidence off execution consistency take those labels from the single database a benchmark ships, an oracle known to be lenient. We run a preregistered intervention on Spider-Realistic, swapping that database for the benchmark's distilled multi-instance test suite. Across four SQL-specialist checkpoints and two split schemes, the swap raises the certificate's held-out risk 2.73 to 10.23 points above the risk its own labels report. Neither oracle reports the risk experts assign. Under blinded labels from two SQL experts, a certificate calibrated at a nominal 0.10 carries 20.0 and 17.2 points of risk on two checkpoints. The stricter oracle errs in both directions: most of the answers it rejects are not judged wrong, and some of those it accepts are. An AI-assigned census of what it rejects finds a semantic error in a quarter to a third of them, depending on the population. It attributes most of the rest to underspecified questions, synthetic instances or suspected reference-query defects, a flag supported by a preregistered blinded expert audit. The oracle also decides how a confidence score is judged. Every execution-consistency score looks better under the labels of the oracle that built its clusters, in 16 of 16 combinations. Under expert labels, building such a score on suite clusters instead of shipped-database clusters raises its area under the ROC curve (AUROC) by 6.96 points on one checkpoint and 1.53 on the other. On the second, the expert interval excludes the 8.3 points the suite labels report. A certificate should be reported with both oracles, and an oracle-relative difference read as semantic risk only after the benchmark is audited. A consistency score should be evaluated under an oracle that did not build it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册干预实验揭示：text-to-SQL 顺从性弃权证书（conformal abstention certificate）的可信度完全依赖于其校准所用的正确性标签。将 Spider-Realistic 的单一数据库替换为多实例测试套件后，证书的留出风险比其自身标签报告的风险高出 2.73–10.23 个百分点，且两种 oracle 均无法反映专家判定的真实风险。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性流水线从执行一致性（execution consistency）中读取置信度，其正确性标签来自基准数据集自带的单一数据库 oracle，而该 oracle 已知过于宽松。作者怀疑这种标签缺陷会系统性低估真实语义风险，并使一致性分数在"建造它的 oracle"下被高估，因此需要一次预注册干预来量化 oracle 选择对顺从性证书与一致性评分的影响。
AI.method: 在 Spider-Realistic 上进行预注册干预：把基准自带的单一数据库 oracle 替换为其蒸馏的多实例测试套件 oracle；覆盖四个 SQL 专用检查点与两种划分方案；以两名 SQL 专家的盲标标签为参照，评估名义 0.10 的顺从性证书的实际风险；用 AI 对拒绝样本进行普查分类，并对分类结果做预注册的盲专家审计；在 16 种组合下比较两种 oracle 对执行一致性 AUROC 的判定，并对比基于套件簇与基于发布数据库簇构建的一致性分数。
AI.result: 1) oracle 替换使证书留出风险比其自身标签报告高出 2.73–10.23 个百分点，两种 oracle 均不报告专家认定的风险。2) 在专家盲标下，名义 0.10 的证书在两个检查点上分别承载 20.0 与 17.2 个百分点的风险。3) 更严格的 oracle 双向出错：其拒绝的答案大多并非被判错，其接受的答案中也有错判。4) AI 普查发现被拒样本中 1/4 到 1/3 存在语义错误，其余多归因于问题表述不充分、合成实例或疑似参考查询缺陷，并获预注册盲专家审计支持。5) 在 16/16 组合中，执行一致性分数在"建造其簇的 oracle"标签下表现更好。6) 在专家标签下，基于套件簇构建的一致性分数相比发布数据库簇，AUROC 分别提升 6.96 与 1.53 个百分点；在第二个检查点上专家区间排除了套件标签报告的 8.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 顺从性证书应同时报告两种 oracle 下的结果，且只有在基准经过审计后，才能把 oracle 相对差异解读为语义风险。此外，一致性分数应在一个并非建造它的 oracle 下进行评估，以避免评价偏置。

title: ClusterFewshot: Improving Few-shot Optimization for LLMs workflow
summary: The performance of large language model (LLM) workflows often depends on selecting a small set of in-context demonstrations to guide model behavior on new tasks. Recent methods improve this process by augmenting prompts with successful reasoning paths. However, their demonstration selection relies on random sampling or metric-based rankings, overlooking the semantic structure of the task. We propose ClusterFewshot, a strategy that combines semantic structuring with utility-aware scoring to construct representative and effective few-shot demonstration sets. Evaluated within DSPy-based pipelines, ClusterFewshot substantially reduces optimization cost across multiple benchmarks, while consistently improving accuracy relative to prior bootstrap-based methods in both standalone prompt tuning and hybrid prompt-weight optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ClusterFewshot，一种结合语义结构化与效用感知打分的少样本演示选择策略，用于提升 LLM 工作流中的上下文演示质量并降低优化成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 工作流性能常依赖少量上下文演示来引导新任务；现有方法虽通过加入成功推理路径改进提示，但演示选择仍依赖随机采样或基于指标的排序，忽视了任务的语义结构，导致演示集合缺乏代表性且优化代价高。
AI.method: 提出 ClusterFewshot：将语义结构化（聚类）与效用感知的打分机制相结合，构建具有代表性且高效的少样本演示集合，并在基于 DSPy 的流水线中评估其效果。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，ClusterFewshot 显著降低了优化成本，同时在独立提示调优与提示-权重混合优化两种设定下，相较此前的 bootstrap 类方法持续提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入任务语义结构并融合效用打分，可有效改善少样本演示选择，兼顾成本降低与精度提升。

title: Towards Systematic Qualification of Vision-Language Models for Automotive Perception Systems
comment: Accepted in ICTSS 2026 - 38th International Conference on Testing Software and Systems
summary: The field of Artificial Intelligence has been adopted for many application domains. Vision Language Models are one of the recently advanced AI techniques that have been explored to support automotive features such as vehicle perception, and safety assurance. However, such language models are prone to hallucinations, posing a potential threat to the safety of automotive systems that may incorporate them. Within the automotive domain, VLMs could not only hallucinate traffic objects, but could also fail to identify traffic objects that are actually present, which may potentially lead to dangerous situations. Though we have observed a growing body of literature that proposes verification and validation techniques for safe and trustworthy AI, these methods are often studied in isolation, focusing either on run-time or design-time phases. Such isolated techniques could be insufficient in safety-critical, realistic contexts such as automotive perception systems. In this paper, we analyze design-time and run-time verification and validation techniques based on a taxonomy presented by Huang et al. We present an automotive study in which a design-time qualification workflow is proposed to complement run-time monitoring. This workflow combines a fixed safety-relevant ontology-based structured annotation system together with a synonym-based evaluation process to statistically evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs against data from the nuScenes dataset. We observed that the proposed technique enables deterministic and repeatable quantification of the hallucinations VLMs generate in automotive perception-related tasks. The proposed workflow supports model comparison and deployment-oriented engineering decisions within the design-time verification and validation process and will contribute to a holistic verification strategy that strives towards trustworthy automotive perception systems

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在汽车感知中的幻觉风险，提出一种设计时资格认证工作流，将其与运行时监控互补，并结合本体驱动的结构化标注与同义词评估，对三种先进VLM在nuScenes数据上的幻觉进行定量评估。
