AI.method: 在FEVEROUS上使用4个训练好的DeBERTa检查点、7,890条claim,比较DCUF与UnifEE证据条件下的strict score与answer accuracy,并做配对95%区间估计;通过仅替换传入scorer的证据(分别保留由DCUF/UnifEE证据生成的答案)分解增益来源。进一步用两个8B LLM在FEVER、FEVEROUS、SciFact上生成470,400条response,设置两种答案格式与两种上下文预算(256 vs 2,048 tokens),检验固定答案证据增益随上下文长度的变化。结合事后分析(四个答案-证据评分组合)检查claim-level模式。
AI.result: strict score在替换为UnifEE证据后提升9.61个百分点,而答案准确率仅提升1.96个百分点;strict gain的配对95%区间为[8.77, 10.43](以这些检查点为条件)。仅替换传入scorer的证据时,保留DCUF答案增益为7.92个百分点,保留UnifEE答案增益为9.08个百分点,表明主要增益来自证据而非答案。上下文从256增至2,048 tokens使FEVEROUS上的固定答案证据增益分别提高3.84(Qwen)和3.10(Llama)个百分点。该效应未达到预设的跨数据集标准,部分区间超出两点小效应界限。
AI.conclusion: 联合事实核查分数的提升主要可由证据替换解释,答案固定后仍有显著增益;但该证据增益依赖上下文预算等评估选择,且不完全满足预设跨数据集稳健性标准。端点与聚合指标(准确率、证据覆盖率)可能掩盖claim-level模式,需要采用答案-证据四组合的细粒度分析。

title: ChipMEM: Verification-Grounded Memory for EDA Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents use Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools to generate and revise register-transfer-level (RTL) designs under synthesis and verification feedback. Recent methods learn from this feedback by distilling reusable skills from execution traces or by training on rewards derived from EDA-tools. Both methods are typically evaluated on the tasks that produced the experience. Repeated access to benchmark feedback on the same task can reward task-specific revision rather than creating reusable knowledge that transfers. We introduce ChipMEM, a verification-grounded memory layer for EDA agents. It combines cross-task procedural memory with within-trajectory statistical guidance. Its procedural component distills and stores a skill only after it passes synthesis, simulation, or formal checks, rather than relying on model self-assessments. A Bayesian component maintains hierarchical Beta estimates over tool-call outcomes and ranks recovery strategies that succeeded under comparable errors. A common adapter applies the same memory interface to RTL optimization and testbench-generation agents while preserving each domain's tools and acceptance criteria. We measure performance on training tasks and evaluate whether learned skills transfer to unseen tasks. On RTLRewriter-Bench, under matched model and tool settings, ChipMEM produces equivalence-passing outputs on 39/54 scored designs versus 35/54 without memory; on the 49-design short suite, mean area improvement is 8.69% versus 5.66%. On held-out CVDP tasks, ChipMEM with a frozen procedural library achieves 20/20 accepted outcomes versus 18/20 without memory in a single evaluation per setting.

AI.tldr: 提出ChipMEM，一种面向EDA智能体的验证接地记忆层，通过跨任务程序性记忆与轨迹内贝叶斯统计引导，提升RTL设计与测试平台生成的效果及跨任务迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的EDA智能体方法（如从执行轨迹蒸馏技能或使用EDA工具奖励训练）通常在产生经验的任务上评估，重复访问同一任务的基准反馈会奖励任务特定的修正而非可迁移的复用知识，导致知识迁移能力不足。
AI.method: ChipMEM结合两类机制：1）程序性记忆组件，仅在技能通过综合、仿真或形式化检查后才蒸馏并存储，不依赖模型自评；2）贝叶斯组件，对工具调用结果维护分层Beta估计，并对在可比错误下成功的恢复策略进行排序。通过统一适配器将相同记忆接口应用于RTL优化与测试平台生成智能体，同时保留各自领域的工具与验收标准。
AI.result: 在RTLRewriter-Bench上，匹配模型与工具设置下，ChipMEM在39/54个计分设计上产生等价通过输出（无记忆为35/54）；49设计短套件上平均面积改进8.69%（无记忆为5.66%）。在留出的CVDP任务上，冻结程序库的ChipMEM取得20/20接受结果（无记忆为18/20）。
AI.conclusion: 验证接地的记忆机制能有效提升EDA智能体的任务表现，且学习到的技能可迁移至未见任务，优于依赖任务反馈的现有方法。

title: Pro-Bench: Prompt-Robust Open-Vocabulary Visual Grounding Across Real-World Heterogeneous Environments
summary: Open-vocabulary visual grounding enables robots to localise task-relevant entities from natural-language queries without dependence on predefined perceptual taxonomies. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on short category labels and web-scraped imagery, leaving it unclear whether open-vocabulary models can robustly ground diverse queries and visual conditions under real deployments. We introduce \textbf{Pro-Bench}, a prompt-conditioned benchmark for open-vocabulary visual grounding in heterogeneous, real-world environments. Pro-Bench includes $13k+$ RGB frames from independent robotic domains (subterranean, industrial, indoor, outdoor, urban), with $74.5k$ manual instance annotations and $515$ target queries covering categorical, attributive, relational, affordance, state, part-whole, negative, and compositional semantics. We benchmarked $16$ open-vocabulary model configurations in strict zero-shot inference, measuring localisation accuracy across IoU thresholds, end-to-end inference latency, prompt-induced performance variation, and target recovery consistency. Our results show that prompt-robustness is strongly architecture-dependent. Most model configurations ($10/16$) perform best with short category labels, whereas free-form queries yield the highest accuracy for only one. Moreover, similar aggregate mAP can conceal substantial differences in consistent target recovery across reformulations. Pro-Bench enables systematic evaluation of these gaps and supports prompt-robust visual grounding. Pro-Bench: https://pro-bench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Pro-Bench，一个面向开放词汇视觉定位的提示条件基准，覆盖异构真实机器人环境与8类语义查询，并对16种开放词汇模型配置进行严格零样本评测。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇视觉定位基准多依赖短类别标签与网络抓取图像，无法反映模型在真实部署中面对多样查询与视觉条件时是否稳健，因此需要更贴近实际场景的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 Pro-Bench：包含来自地下、工业、室内、室外、城市等独立机器人领域的13k+ RGB帧、74.5k人工实例标注和515个目标查询，查询语义涵盖类别、属性、关系、可供性、状态、部分-整体、否定与组合语义；对16种开放词汇模型配置进行严格零样本推理评测，测量多IoU阈值下的定位精度、端到端推理时延、提示引起的性能波动及目标恢复一致性。
AI.result: 提示稳健性强烈依赖模型架构；16种配置中10种在短类别标签下表现最佳，仅1种在自由形式查询下精度最高；相近的总体mAP可能掩盖不同查询改写下目标恢复一致性的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: Pro-Bench可系统评估开放词汇视觉定位在真实异构环境中的提示稳健性缺口，为提示稳健的视觉定位研究提供支持。

title: Heartian: Physiology-Aware Relightable Gaussian Head Avatar
comment: 4 pages of manuscript and 2 pages of supplementary material; SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: Gaussian head avatars typically model intrinsic facial appearance as temporally static, omitting subtle cardiac-induced skin-color variation. We propose Heartian, a physiology-aware modulation framework that learns cardiac-cycle-dependent per-frame albedo modulation of facial skin-region Gaussians within a relightable head avatar to encode remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) signals. Using synchronized contact PPG supervision, Heartian models the prescribed cardiac waveform as the sum of two Gaussian functions and learns per-frame spatial residuals via a lightweight MLP. Across 152 stationary recordings from UBFC-rPPG, PURE, and MMPD, attribute-space recovery of the supplied signal achieves a pooled recording-level heart-rate MAE of 0.29 bpm and MAPE of 0.38%. The signals remain detectable after rendering by benchmark rPPG methods, with the best tested configuration - a motion-augmented TS-CAN decoder pretrained on UBFC-rPPG - recovering heart rate from the rendered MMPD avatars at 0.97 bpm MAE and 1.21% MAPE. Meanwhile, Heartian maintains reconstruction quality comparable to the baseline, with negligible average PSNR degradation of 0.005 dB. Overall, our work embeds recoverable rPPG signals as controllable material attributes to subject-specific Gaussian head avatars while retaining the reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Heartian 框架，在可重光照的高斯头部化身中学习随心动周期变化的逐帧 albedo 调制，将 rPPG 信号嵌入为可控材质属性，同时保持重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯头部化身通常将面部固有外观建模为时间上静态的，忽略了由心脏搏动引起的细微肤色变化，因此无法表征 rPPG 信号。
AI.method: 将指定心动波形建模为两个高斯函数之和，对皮肤区域高斯的 albedo 进行逐帧调制，并用轻量 MLP 学习逐帧空间残差；使用同步接触式 PPG 作为监督，在可重光照头部化身框架下训练。
AI.result: 在 UBFC-rPPG、PURE、MMPD 共 152 段静态录制上，属性空间恢复信号的心率 MAE 为 0.29 bpm、MAPE 为 0.38%；渲染后信号仍可被基准 rPPG 方法检测，最佳配置（运动增强 TS-CAN 解码器，UBFC-rPPG 预训练）在渲染的 MMPD 化身上达到 0.97 bpm MAE、1.21% MAPE；重建质量与基线相当，平均 PSNR 仅下降 0.005 dB。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明可将可恢复的 rPPG 信号作为可控材质属性嵌入个体化高斯头部化身，在保留重建质量的同时实现生理感知的面部外观建模。

title: NADI 2026: The Second Multidialectal Arabic Speech Processing Shared Task
summary: NADI 2026 is the seventh edition of the Nuanced Arabic Dialect Identification (NADI) shared task series and the second dedicated to multidialectal Arabic speech processing. This edition comprises five tasks and eight subtasks spanning Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Spoken Dialect Identification (SDID), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Spoken Language Translation (SLT), and Spoken Language Understanding (SLU). NADI 2026 emphasizes realistic evaluation through low-bandwidth, mixed-dialect, code-switched, out-of-domain, and zero-shot settings, while introducing TTS, SLT, and SLU to the series for the first time. The shared task attracted 21 participating teams from at least 13 countries, with 48 test-phase submissions and 14 submitted system-description papers. Results show that out-of-domain generalization remains a major bottleneck and highlight the effectiveness of recent Arabic-specialized speech models, multimodal dialect identification approaches, and ensemble methods. Overall, NADI 2026 provides a broader and more challenging benchmark for robust Arabic dialect speech processing.

AI.tldr: NADI 2026 是第七届阿拉伯语方言识别共享任务，第二届聚焦多方言阿拉伯语语音处理，设5项任务8个子任务，覆盖ASR、SDID、TTS、SLT、SLU，吸引21支队伍参赛，结果表明域外泛化仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 推动多方言阿拉伯语语音处理研究，并通过低带宽、混合方言、语码转换、域外与零样本等设置实现更贴近真实的评测；首次将TTS、SLT、SLU引入该系列以扩展任务范围。
AI.method: 组织NADI 2026共享任务：设置5项任务、8个子任务，涵盖ASR、SDID、TTS、SLT、SLU；采用低带宽、混合方言、语码转换、域外及零样本等评测设定；参赛队伍提交系统并撰写系统描述论文（共14篇）。
AI.result: 共有来自至少13个国家的21支队伍参赛，测试阶段提交48份结果、14篇系统描述论文。结果显示域外泛化仍是主要瓶颈；近期阿拉伯语专用语音模型、多模态方言识别方法以及集成方法效果显著。
AI.conclusion: NADI 2026为鲁棒的阿拉伯语方言语音处理提供了更广泛、更具挑战性的基准，并指明域外泛化等关键难点。

title: Pose-Aware Multimodal Automatic Tagging for Greek Traditional Music
summary: Automatic tagging is a core task in Music Information Retrieval (MIR), yet most tagging systems exploit only audio. Live music performance is inherently multimodal, as semantic labels such as instruments, regional styles, and dance forms are encoded simultaneously across acoustic, visual, and embodied performance cues. This is especially true of culturally specific repertoires such as Greek traditional music, which remain underrepresented in MIR benchmarks. In this paper, we investigate whether the use of dancer pose provides complementary information for automatic tagging in Greek traditional music beyond audio. Using the Lyra dataset, we extend prior audio-only work by extracting aligned video features and pose-derived skeleton streams, enabling an experimental setting for multimodal auto-tagging. We further introduce an automated pipeline for extracting primary-dancer skeleton sequences from in-the-wild dance footage, combining dance-scene detection, multi-person tracking, dancer selection, pose estimation, and quality filtering. We compare unimodal, all bimodal combinations, and trimodal systems using multiple fusion strategies. Audio remains the strongest single modality (AST: macro ROC-AUC 0.821), while skeletons, though weak in isolation, enhance performance through multimodal fusion. The best trimodal system improves macro ROC-AUC by about 4 percentage points over the strongest audio baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究希腊传统音乐自动标注，通过构建视频与舞者姿态骨架流并与音频融合，验证多模态（尤其三模态）相对纯音频的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐自动标注系统多仅利用音频，而现场音乐表演本质上是多模态的：乐器、地域风格、舞曲形式等语义标签同时编码在声学、视觉与身体表演线索中。希腊传统音乐等文化特定曲目在MIR基准中代表性不足，因此需要探索舞者姿态等视觉信息能否为音频之外提供互补信息。
AI.method: 基于Lyra数据集扩展此前的纯音频工作，提取对齐的视频特征与姿态导出的骨架流，构建多模态自动标注实验设置。提出自动化流程从真实舞蹈视频中提取主舞者骨架序列，包含舞蹈场景检测、多人跟踪、舞者选择、姿态估计与质量过滤。系统比较单模态、所有双模态组合及三模态系统，并采用多种融合策略。
AI.result: 音频仍是最强单模态（AST：macro ROC-AUC 0.821）；骨架单模态性能较弱，但通过多模态融合可提升整体表现。最佳三模态系统相较最强音频基线，macro ROC-AUC 提升约4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 舞者姿态骨架虽单独作用有限，但作为互补模态可有效增强希腊传统音乐自动标注性能，凸显多模态融合在文化特定MIR任务中的价值。

title: Adaptive Tiling for Least-Squares Phase Unwrapping: Runtime and Accuracy
comment: Technical report. 15 pages of main text and references, followed by 8 pages of supplementary material. 6 figures, 8 tables and 2 algorithms in total
summary: Phase unwrapping estimates the missing multiples of $2π$ in measured phase images. For large images, tiling limits the size of local reconstruction problems and enables parallel processing. Adaptive tiling could further reduce the number of local problems and boundaries by retaining large tiles where little refinement is needed. We investigate whether this reduction makes reconstruction faster. We compare complete reconstruction time and accuracy for a regular grid, quadtree, and kd-tree partitions. We also evaluate nine criteria for deciding where quadtree tiles should be subdivided, including residue count, fringe density, and measures of phase variation, at different tile sizes and budgets. In single-threaded experiments on a heterogeneous image dataset, optimized adaptive partitions use fewer tiles but remain slower than the optimized grid, and some reconstructions lose substantial accuracy. Stage measurements explain why: constructing the partition and solving larger retained tiles outweigh the savings at tile boundaries. The criterion comparison also shows that more refinement does not consistently improve accuracy. These results motivate evaluating adaptive partitions by the complete time needed to reach a chosen reconstruction accuracy, including whether limited refinement can provide a faster approximate result.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了规则网格、四叉树和kd树三种分块策略在相位解缠中的完整重建时间与精度，发现优化的自适应分区虽使用更少分块，但整体仍慢于优化网格，且部分重建精度显著下降。
AI.motivation: 大尺寸相位图像的分块处理可限制局部重建问题规模并支持并行。自适应分块理论上可通过在细节较少区域保留大分块来减少局部问题数量与边界，但这一减少是否真正加快重建尚不清楚，作者希望系统评估自适应分区（四叉树/kd树）相对于规则网格在完整重建时间与精度上的表现，并考察细分判据的有效性。
AI.method: 在单线程实验下，使用异构图像数据集，比较规则网格、四叉树与kd树三种分区的完整重建时间与精度；同时评估九种用于决定四叉树叶节点是否细分的判据（包括残差点计数、条纹密度、相位变化度量等），并在不同分块尺寸与预算设置下进行对比。
AI.result: 优化的自适应分区使用更少分块，但整体重建仍慢于优化网格，且部分重建精度大幅下降。阶段测量表明原因在于：构建分区与求解保留的大分块的开销超过了减少边界带来的收益。判据比较还显示，更多细分并不一致地提升精度。
AI.conclusion: 自适应分区不应仅以分块数量或边界数量评价，而应以达到目标重建精度所需的完整时间（含构建与求解）来评估；同时需考虑有限细分是否能提供更快的近似结果。

title: Feed the Panel Dimensions, Not Verdicts: Rubric-Decomposed Fusion of Vision-Language Aesthetic Judges
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are deployed as zero-shot judges of image aesthetics, and panels of several models are recommended, on thin evidence, as the way to make such judges reliable. On two human-rated datasets, EVA and PARA, we find that a panel of holistic judges never significantly beats its best member, whether the verdicts are averaged or fused by a learned combiner. What a panel is worth depends on what it is fed. We therefore have each model score each image on the five dimensions of a frozen, human-written rubric and fuse those scores, alongside each model's verdict, across model families with an out-of-fold combiner. The dimension scores measure what their labels claim: with the overall human score partialled out, a dimension prompt carries more attribute-specific information than the holistic prompt in 28 of 30 model-attribute cells. Fused, they beat the best single VLM in all ten three-family panels on EVA (against that best single model, +0.07 Spearman rho for the strongest trio and +0.10 for the pre-declared one, and +0.06 and +0.07 when averaged over twenty fold partitions; against the panel mean, the primary test gives +0.118 on its EVA design set), and on PARA they reach parity under Spearman rho and a small, non-significant loss under Kendall tau-b, where one model already captures 85% of the human noise ceiling. It is not a feature-count artefact: giving the same combiner an equal number of pure holistic columns, split from the same repetitions, does not reproduce it. The gain costs a few hundred labels, which do not transfer between datasets, and 4.8x the API calls on EVA; we report it with paired bootstraps and Kendall tau-b, alongside a failed pre-registration and the configurations that lost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLM作为图像美学零样本评判者的可靠性问题，发现多模型"评审团"并不优于其最佳成员；但改用冻结的人类撰写评分量表的五个维度分别打分再融合，可在EVA和部分PARA指标上超越最佳单模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）被用作图像美学的零样本评判者，且有建议认为多模型组成"评审团"能提升可靠性，但该建议缺乏充分证据。作者希望检验评审团的实际价值，并寻找能真正提升评判性能的输入形式。
AI.method: 在EVA与PARA两个有人类评分的数据集上，比较整体性（holistic）评审团与最佳单模型的表现（含平均融合与学习式融合）。随后让每个模型按冻结的人类撰写量表的五个维度分别评分，并将维度分数与各模型整体判断一起，通过跨模型家族的out-of-fold组合器进行融合。使用配对bootstrap与Kendall tau-b评估，并进行消融（等量纯整体列）与成本核算，同时报告一次失败的预注册及失败配置。
AI.result: 整体性评审团（无论平均或学习融合）从未显著优于其最佳成员。维度分数确实测量其标签所指属性：在剔除人类总体分后，30个模型-属性单元中有28个显示维度提示比整体提示携带更多属性特异性信息。融合后在EVA全部10个三家族评审团上均超过最佳单VLM（最强三模型+0.07 Spearman rho，预声明组合+0.10；二十折平均为+0.06与+0.07；相对评审团均值，主检验在设计集上为+0.118）；PARA上Spearman rho达到持平，Kendall tau-b有小幅不显著损失，且其中一个模型已捕捉85%的人类噪声上限。等量纯整体列无法复现该增益，排除特征数量假象。代价为数百个标签（不可跨数据集迁移）与EVA上4.8倍的API调用。
AI.conclusion: 多模型整体评审团并不优于最佳成员，评审团价值取决于所输入的信号；以人类量表维度分解并跨模型家族融合，可稳定超越最佳单VLM，但增益需付出标签与算力成本，且本文如实报告了失败预注册与失败配置。

title: Damnatio Memoriae: Adversarially and Selectively Forgetting Identities in the Embedding Space of Face Recognition Models
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. This work might be submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: A face recognition model links two images of a person recorded on separate occasions when their embedding similarity exceeds an operating threshold. We consider making chosen identities unlinkable across separate occasions while the model remains in service for the rest of the population. Deleting their images and retraining does not achieve this, since the model recognises identities never observed in training. Therefore, the embedding space must be altered against these identities, the process of which we call open-set adversarial forgetting. We propose three loss functions, one that disperses an identity's embeddings from their centroid, and two that map each image onto its own near-orthogonal target, learnt with the classifier head or fixed in advance as an almost-orthonormal frame. Each is fine-tuned alongside the classification objective on a subset of each identity's images. We evaluate them against four methods from prior work in verification and identification, at two forget scales and three backbones. Every loss acting on the embedding geometry makes the forget identities nearly unidentifiable. The orthonormal frame alone achieves strong forgetting, which holds wherever an image of that subset enters the comparison and leaves distinct forget identities unlinkable. It also surpasses a concurrent unsupervised method at a higher retain rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"开放集对抗遗忘"（open-set adversarial forgetting）：在模型继续为其余人群服务的前提下，使指定身份在不同场合拍摄的图像无法被链接，并提出三种损失函数实现这一目标。
AI.motivation: 删除图像并重训无法奏效，因为模型能识别训练中从未出现的身份。因此必须针对这些身份直接改变嵌入空间几何，使其被"遗忘"而非仅被移除。
AI.method: 提出三种损失函数：一种使某身份的嵌入远离其质心；另两种将每张图像映射到各自近似正交的目标上，分别通过与分类器头联合学习或预先固定为近似正交规范框架（orthonormal frame）。这些损失在每个身份图像子集上与分类目标联合微调。
AI.result: 在验证与识别任务上，与四类先验方法对比，覆盖两种遗忘规模与三种骨干网络。所有作用于嵌入几何的损失均使遗忘身份几乎不可识别；仅正交规范框架即可实现强遗忘，且在该子集图像参与比较的任何情况下均成立，并使不同遗忘身份间不可链接；在更高保留率下还超越了同期的一种无监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对身份直接改造嵌入空间几何的损失函数，可在不损害模型对普通人群服务能力的前提下，实现对指定身份的开放集遗忘，其中预先固定的近似正交规范框架方案效果突出且稳健。

title: Beyond Volume Overlap: Surface Matching for Topology-Aware Coronary Artery Segmentation
comment: 12 Pages, 2 figures, Statistical Atlases and Computational Modeling of the Heart (STACOM) workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate coronary artery segmentation on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease. Deep networks are conventionally trained and evaluated with the Dice coefficient, but volume-overlap metrics are poorly suited to thin, tubular anatomy: since most voxels belong to a few thickproximal segments, a missing distal branch barely affects Dice despite severely disrupting the connectivity required for clinical use. We introduce a surface metric that matches predicted and reference surface points via bipartite assignment under a localized, vessel-radius tolerance, reporting precision, recall, and F1 with decoupled false positives (spurious branches) and false negatives (missed branches) a distinction the symmetric Dice cannot make. With it we show that a strong Dice-trained baseline omits far more vessel surface than it hallucinates, an asymmetry its high Dice hides. Building on this, we propose a differentiable surface loss that simultaneously suppresses spurious mass and recovers absent structure, validated by fine-tuning three backbones (nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, NexToU) on two public benchmarks (Image-CAS, ASOCA). Against a matched-epoch control, it significantly improves surface F1 by recovering missed distal vessels at comparable Dice. Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code

AI.tldr: 该研究针对CCTA冠状动脉分割中Dice指标对细管状结构不敏感的问题，提出一种基于表面点匹配的评测指标与可微表面损失，在三类骨干、两个数据集上显著提升表面F1并恢复远端血管。
AI.motivation: 冠脉在CCTA上的精确分割对冠心病诊断至关重要，但Dice等体积重叠指标不适配细管状解剖：多数体素属于少数粗大的近端段，因此遗漏一条远端分支对Dice几乎无影响，却严重破坏临床所需的血管连通性。同时，对称的Dice无法区分假阳性（虚假分支）与假阴性（漏检分支）。
AI.method: 1) 提出表面度量：在局部、与血管半径相关的容差下，通过二分图指派匹配预测表面点与参考表面点，分别报告precision、recall与F1，并解耦假阳性与假阴性。2) 基于该度量提出可微表面损失，同时抑制虚假团块并找回缺失结构。3) 在nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU三种骨干上，于Image-CAS与ASOCA两个公开基准做微调验证。
AI.result: 用该表面度量发现，以Dice训练的理想基线其漏检的血管表面远多于其虚构的表面，这种不对称被高Dice值掩盖。与同epoch数控制组相比，所提表面损失在Dice相当的情况下显著提升表面F1，主要通过恢复被漏检的远端血管实现。
AI.conclusion: 应测量并优化血管表面本身，而非其重叠的体积；表面指标与表面损失能揭示并纠正Dice所掩盖的漏检偏差，更契合临床对血管连通性的需求。

title: From greenhouse climate to individual leaves: an organ-resolved model of lettuce growth
comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 8 tables. Includes an appendix with supporting information
summary: Greenhouse climate management aims to improve crop production while limiting energy use. This requires knowing how a crop will respond before conditions are changed. A crop digital twin can support this decision only if it represents how plant physiology and structure develop together. A unified framework was developed to simulate lettuce growth from the physiology of individual leaves. Each leaf received the conditions at its position in the canopy and contributed carbon through photosynthesis. Part of this carbon was used for maintenance and the remainder supported growth, distributed among leaves by their age, size and local environment. The predicted leaf mass, area and age generated an evolving three-dimensional plant in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Ray tracing calculated the radiation intercepted by each leaf and returned it to photosynthesis, so structure and growth influenced each other over time. Against greenhouse measurements, the relative root mean square error was 9.5% for total dry weight and 9.2%, 12.7% and 13.1% for leaf number, canopy diameter and largest-leaf area, respectively. A 30% decrease in incident radiation reduced final dry weight by 10.4%, while the same increase raised it by 6.9%, and adding 200 ppm carbon dioxide raised it by 46.1%. Within a simulated 40-plant block, interior plants accumulated 8.6% less dry weight than border plants with identical initial states, and the leaf-specific tipburn index rose in the enclosed leaves over the period in which tipburn appeared on the greenhouse plants. Resolving individual leaves therefore explains how local exposure changes plant growth within the greenhouse. The framework provides the forward plant model needed for a bidirectional digital twin, where observations of the physical plant can update predictions and support greenhouse climate decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了从单叶生理到三维结构的生菜作物数字孪生前向模型，在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中耦合光合作用与冠层光截获，总干重相对均方根误差9.5%，并能复现局部微环境差异与叶尖burn现象。
AI.motivation: 温室气候管理需在改变环境前预知作物响应，而现有作物数字孪生难以同时刻画植物生理与结构的协同发育，缺乏可用于双向数字孪生的前向植物模型。
AI.method: 建立统一框架，从单叶生理出发模拟生菜生长：每片叶按其冠层位置获取环境条件并通过光合作用贡献碳；碳经维持呼吸后按叶龄、大小和局部环境分配于各叶生长；预测的叶质量、面积与叶龄生成NVIDIA Isaac Sim中的动态三维植株；用光线追踪计算各叶截获辐射并反馈至光合作用，实现结构与生长的时变耦合。
AI.result: 与温室实测相比，总干重相对均方根误差为9.5%，叶数、冠层直径和最大叶面积分别为9.2%、12.7%和13.1%。入射辐射降低30%使最终干重下降10.4%，等量增加使其提高6.9%，增加200 ppm二氧化碳使其提高46.1%。在40株模拟小区中，内部植株干重比边界植株低8.6%；叶特异性叶尖burn指数在封闭叶片中升高，与温室植株出现叶尖burn的时期一致。
AI.conclusion: 以单叶分辨率建模可解释局部暴露如何改变温室内植株生长，该框架为双向数字孪生提供了所需的前向植物模型，使物理植株观测能更新预测并支撑温室气候决策。

title: PEARL: A Lightweight Prompt-based Feature Interpreter Framework for Real-Time, Anonymous, and Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
summary: Heterogeneity across Collaborative Perception (CP) agents is a major challenge for emerging CP frameworks due to domain gaps from differing sensors, architectures, and training data. Prior works mitigate this challenge by aligning features in a unified space via model retraining or per-agent-type interpreters. These strategies (a) require access to neighbor configurations, (b) do not fully address real-time CP deployment, and (c) generalize poorly to unseen agents joining at run time. To overcome these challenges, we present PEARL, a Prompt-Embedding framework for Anonymous and Real-time Lightweight heterogeneous CP. PEARL supports multiple CP interpreters and selects one for a new-joining agent in real time using two lightweight, multi-scale interpreters trained in parallel: a sparse-detection (LWSD) interpreter that aligns salient regions for cooperative detection, and a dense, domain-invariant (LWDDI) interpreter that produces agent-invariant features for fast interpreter selection. Both interpreters use low-rank visual prompts to reduce computation, storage, and model complexity. Extensive experiments on simulated (OPV2V, V2XSet) and real (DAIR-V2X) datasets show that PEARL generalizes across simulated and real-world cooperative driving scenarios. Its real-time model-selection strategy yields an 8.2% Average Precision (AP) gain over a random-selection baseline while running in 1.67 ms on average. Although primarily designed for real-time CP, PEARL also outperforms state-of-the-art heterogeneous CP frameworks under traditional offline training by 5.6% AP on average while reducing communication cost by up to 34.7 times. Equally important, PEARL does not require sharing agents' configurations or model settings, thereby protecting information that may be proprietary or private. These results establish PEARL as a scalable and practical framework for heterogeneous collaborative perception.

AI.tldr: PEARL 是一个基于提示嵌入（Prompt-Embedding）的框架，用于解决协同感知（CP）中异构智能体带来的域差异问题，支持匿名、实时、轻量化的异构协同感知，在仿真与真实数据集上兼顾精度、实时性与通信效率。
AI.motivation: 协同感知中不同智能体因传感器、架构与训练数据差异产生域鸿沟，异构性成为主要挑战。已有方法通过统一特征空间对齐（模型重训练或按智能体类型设置解释器）来缓解，但存在三重局限：(a) 需获取邻居配置信息；(b) 未充分满足实时部署需求；(c) 对运行时新加入的未见智能体泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出 PEARL，一种用于匿名、实时、轻量化异构 CP 的提示嵌入框架。框架维护多个 CP 解释器，并采用两个并行训练的轻量级多尺度解释器为新加入智能体实时选择其一：稀疏检测解释器（LWSD）对齐显著区域以支持协同检测；稠密域不变解释器（LWDDI）生成智能体不变特征以支撑快速解释器选择。两种解释器均使用低秩视觉提示以降低计算量、存储与模型复杂度，且无需共享智能体的配置或模型设置。
AI.result: 在仿真数据集（OPV2V、V2XSet）与真实数据集（DAIR-V2X）上的大量实验表明，PEARL 可跨仿真与真实协同驾驶场景泛化。其实时模型选择策略相较随机选择基线取得 8.2% 的 AP 提升，平均运行耗时 1.67 ms。在传统离线训练设定下，PEARL 相较最先进的异构 CP 框架平均提升 5.6% AP，同时通信开销最多降低 34.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: PEARL 在不共享智能体配置或模型设置（保护专有或隐私信息）的前提下，兼顾实时模型选择与异构协同感知性能，验证了其作为可扩展、实用异构协同感知框架的有效性。

title: Super-Resolution of Solar Magnetograms via Adaptive Stratified Ensemble Learning with Uncertainty Estimation
summary: Single-image super-resolution of Sun's photospheric magnetograms enables consistent analysis across heterogeneous space-based instruments and supports long-term studies of solar magnetic field evolution. We address the super-resolution task from SOHO/MDI (low-resolution) to SDO/HMI (high-resolution) line-of-sight (LOS) magnetograms using a modified RRDBNet architecture initialized by ESRGAN pretrained weights. Through systematic per-image diagnostic analysis, we identify image complexity as the dominant predictor of reconstruction errors. To exploit this finding, we introduce an adaptive stratified specialist ensemble (SSE) of three specialist networks with uncertainty estimation, where each specialist network is trained by images from three different complexity strata using a weighted random sampling strategy. During inference, a lightweight router based on input image statistics assigns each test image to the appropriate specialist network. Our experimental results demonstrate the good performance of the proposed ensemble and its superiority over closely related methods.

AI.tldr: 提出基于改进RRDBNet与自适应分层专家集成(SSE)的方法，实现SOHO/MDI到SDO/HMI太阳光球视向磁图的单图超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 太阳光球磁图的单图超分辨率可实现异构天基仪器间的一致分析，并支撑太阳磁场演化的长期研究；但重建误差受图像特性影响显著，需要针对性建模。
AI.method: 采用经ESRGAN预训练权重初始化的改进RRDBNet架构；通过逐图像诊断分析发现图像复杂度是重建误差的主导预测因子；据此构建由三个专家网络组成的自适应分层专家集成(SSE)，各专家分别在三个不同复杂度层级的图像上以加权随机采样策略训练，并引入不确定性估计；推理阶段由基于输入图像统计量的轻量级路由器为每张测试图像分配相应专家网络。
AI.result: 实验结果表明所提集成方法性能良好，并优于密切相关方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证了以图像复杂度分层并配合路由与不确定性估计的专家集成策略在跨仪器磁图超分辨率任务中的有效性。

title: A Hierarchy-Aware Video-Language Model Evaluation and Hyperbolic Baseline for Surgery
summary: Surgical procedures follow a phase-to-step hierarchy, yet the video-language models used to recognize them are evaluated with flat per-level metrics that ignore cross-level coherence and error structure. In this paper we make two contributions to address this problem, (i) we introduce SurgHiBench, the first hierarchy-aware evaluation suite for surgical video understanding, with three tasks measuring recognition, consistency, and severity across granularity levels. We evaluate a general-purpose CLIP model, a Euclidean surgical model, and, as second contribution: (ii) HyperSurg, a new hyperbolic model that enforces phase-step containment via entailment cones, across four (existing) datasets spanning three procedure types. The suite reveals that two models with the same accuracy can produce predictions of very different error severity, ranging from sibling confusions within the correct phase to unrelated cross-phase predictions. Hyperbolic geometry shifts predictions toward the correct procedural neighborhood, and these gains scale with the tree-likeness of each dataset's annotation hierarchy, providing a principled indicator when hierarchy-aware geometry helps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SurgHiBench层次感知评测套件与双曲模型HyperSurg，用于外科视频理解，揭示单一准确率指标掩盖的跨层次连贯性与错误严重度差异。
AI.motivation: 外科手术遵循"阶段—步骤"层次结构，但现有视频-语言模型仅采用各层级独立的扁平指标（per-level metrics）进行评估，忽略了跨层次连贯性与错误结构，导致相同准确率下模型的实际错误严重程度可能差异巨大。
AI.method: 工作包含两部分：(i) 构建SurgHiBench——首个面向外科视频理解的层次感知评测套件，含识别、一致性、严重度三项任务，跨粒度层级评估；(ii) 提出HyperSurg双曲模型，通过蕴含锥（entailment cones）强制实现"阶段包含步骤"的层次约束。在覆盖三类术式的四个已有数据集上，对比通用CLIP模型、欧氏外科模型与HyperSurg。
AI.result: 评测显示，准确率相同的两个模型其预测错误严重度可显著不同，范围从正确阶段内的兄弟节点混淆，到无关的跨阶段预测。双曲几何将预测推向正确的流程邻域，且该增益随各数据集标注层次树状度（tree-likeness）的提高而增大。
AI.conclusion: 扁平准确率不足以刻画外科视频模型的层次化错误结构；双曲几何可有效提升层次一致性，且数据标注层次的树状度可作为判断层次感知几何是否有益的原理性指标。

title: MINER: Multi-crop INference-time Enhancement for Rare-Object Retrieval with Frozen Dual Encoders
summary: Text-to-image retrieval with frozen dual encoders degrades when the query names a small, visually subordinate object in a cluttered scene: a single global image embedding underrepresents the localized visual evidence. We present MINER, a training-free inference framework that augments a frozen dual encoder's global image embedding with a small bank of region-level embeddings and a hubness-correcting similarity rescoring, recovering visual evidence that global pooling underweights. To evaluate this setting, we introduce ROCS, a benchmark built from high-clutter subsets of Flickr30K and MS COCO whose images are re-captioned to name a single low-salience object. Experiments on CLIP, SigLIP, and SigLIP 2 show that MINER improves retrieval on every backbone, on ROCS and on the standard splits. Analyses show that these gains come primarily from broader spatial coverage rather than precise crop placement, revealing a simple and general way to recover localized evidence from frozen representations. Code: https://github.com/aalquwayfili/MINER. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/aalquwayfili/ROCS.

AI.tldr: 冻结双编码器在"查询指向杂乱场景中视觉上不显著的小物体"时检索性能退化，因为单一全局图像嵌入无法表征局部视觉证据。作者提出 MINER（免训练推理框架）与 ROCS 基准，在多个骨干网络与数据划分上稳定提升检索效果。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像检索普遍依赖冻结双编码器（如 CLIP/SigLIP）的单一全局图像嵌入。当查询描述的是杂乱场景中被全局池化"稀释"的次要小物体时，全局嵌入对局部视觉证据的表征不足，导致检索性能下降。作者希望在不重新训练模型的前提下恢复这类被低估的局部证据。
AI.method: 提出 MINER：一个免训练的推理框架，在冻结双编码器的全局图像嵌入基础上，引入 (1) 小型区域级嵌入库（region-level embeddings bank），(2) 矫正 hubness 问题的相似度重打分（hubness-correcting similarity rescoring），从而补回全局池化所低估的视觉证据。同时构建 ROCS 基准：取自 Flickr30K 与 MS COCO 的高杂乱度子集，并重新撰写描述以指向单个低显著性物体。
AI.result: 在 CLIP、SigLIP、SigLIP 2 三种骨干上，MINER 在 ROCS 及标准划分上均提升检索性能。消融分析表明性能增益主要来自更广的空间覆盖（broader spatial coverage），而非精确的裁剪位置（precise crop placement）。
AI.conclusion: MINER 提供了一种简单且通用的方法，可从冻结表征中恢复局部视觉证据，并证明局部证据不足是全局池化的固有局限；ROCS 为该场景提供了针对性评测基准。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Infrastructure-Based Radar System for Highway Traffic Monitoring
comment: Accepted by IEEE ITSC 2026. Compared with the accepted version, this version includes an expanded trajectory tracking analysis with additional evaluation metrics
summary: Infrastructure-based radar systems offer robust and long-range solutions for traffic monitoring, yet their detection and tracking performance under real-world conditions remains insufficiently evaluated. This study introduces DRaT (Drone and Radar Trajectories), a dual-modality dataset of naturalistic vehicle trajectories collected at a highway merging segment in Fort Worth, Texas, to systematically assess radar sensing performance against drone-derived ground truth. The performance is evaluated at three levels: individual vehicle detection, trajectory tracking, and macroscopic traffic parameter estimation. For individual vehicle detection, the radar achieves an overall precision of 78% and a recall of 57%, with degraded performance under congested traffic conditions and at longer distances. At the trajectory level, the radar demonstrates reasonably strong tracking performance (IDF1 = 0.699), maintaining reliable vehicle identities when tracks are successfully established. For macroscopic traffic flow metrics, the radar accurately estimates space-mean speed (MAPE < 4%) but underestimates density and volume by approximately 23% due to missed detections. The paper also discusses practical deployment considerations and potential downstream applications of roadside radar sensing systems. To support reproducible research on infrastructure-based sensing systems, we have open-sourced the DRaT dataset on Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20171110.

AI.tldr: 该研究发布DRaT数据集（德州高速合流段无人机与雷达双模态车辆轨迹），从单车检测、轨迹跟踪、宏观交通参数三层面评估路侧雷达性能：检测精度78%、召回57%；IDF1=0.699；速度MAPE<4%，但密度与流量低估约23%。
AI.motivation: 路侧雷达虽具备长距离、稳健的交通监测能力，但其在真实道路条件下的检测与跟踪性能缺乏系统评估，尤其是缺少与高精度真值的对照验证。
AI.method: 构建DRaT双模态数据集，在德克萨斯州Fort Worth高速公路合流段采集自然驾驶车辆轨迹，以无人机轨迹为地面真值，对雷达数据在三个层级开展评估：个体车辆检测、轨迹跟踪、宏观交通流参数估计。
AI.result: 个体检测整体精确率78%、召回率57%，在拥堵工况与远距离下性能下降；轨迹跟踪IDF1=0.699，成功建立轨迹时身份保持较可靠；宏观指标中空间平均速度估计准确（MAPE<4%），但密度与流量因漏检被低估约23%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过开源DRaT数据集与多层级评估框架，量化了路侧雷达的实际能力与局限，并讨论了部署考量与下游应用，为可复现的基础设施感知研究提供支撑。

title: Temporally Ordered Region-Token Mamba with Logit-Space Diffusion for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Remote sensing change detection requires both global reasoning across bitemporal images and precise localization of changed regions. However, dense attention is computationally expensive for high-resolution imagery, while conventional feature fusion and coarse decoding may inadequately separate genuine changes from appearance variations or preserve object boundaries. We present Bitemporal Mamba-Diffusion for Change Detection (BMD-CD), which combines temporally structured state-space modeling with logit-space diffusion refinement. BMD-CD converts deep bitemporal features into region tokens and arranges them in explicit temporal partitions before bidirectional state-space propagation. Its Bitemporal Ordered Mamba Operator enables long-range cross-temporal interaction with linear sequence complexity, while Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement forms a change-oriented output and a complementary rotated output using learned pairwise rotations and unchanged-region consistency. Multiscale decoding then produces coarse change logits, which are refined through a five-step Conditional Diffusion Decoder operating directly in logit space. Experiments on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, DSIFN-CD, CDD, and S2Looking demonstrate strong performance across diverse change-detection settings. BMD-CD achieves F1 scores of 93.7%, 96.0%, 97.8%, and 99.0% on the four standard benchmarks and improves 3-pixel Boundary-F1 to 87.7% and 91.4% on LEVIR-CD and WHU-CD, respectively. The full model requires 32.09 GFLOPs and 47 ms per 256 x 256 image pair, while also showing zero-shot transfer to ValaisCD and B-FLAIR-test. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aparup2139/Public_WACV/

AI.tldr: 提出 BMD-CD，将双时相状态空间建模与 logit 空间扩散精修结合用于遥感变化检测，兼顾全局推理与边界定位。
AI.motivation: 遥感变化检测需同时具备跨双时相图像的全局推理与变化区域精确定位能力。但密集注意力在高分辨率影像上计算代价高昂，而常规特征融合与粗糙解码难以有效区分真实变化与表观差异，且难以保留目标边界。
AI.method: 将深层双时相特征转为区域 token，按显式时间分区排列后进行双向状态空间传播；设计 Bitemporal Ordered Mamba Operator 以线性复杂度实现长程跨时相交互；Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement 通过学习的成对旋转与未变化区域一致性生成变化导向输出及互补旋转输出；多尺度解码产生粗变化 logits，再由五步 Conditional Diffusion Decoder 直接在 logit 空间精修。
AI.result: 在 LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD、DSIFN-CD、CDD、S2Looking 上验证。四个标准基准 F1 分别达 93.7%、96.0%、97.8%、99.0%；LEVIR-CD 与 WHU-CD 的 3 像素 Boundary-F1 提升至 87.7% 和 91.4%。整模型每对 256×256 图像需 32.09 GFLOPs、47 ms，并可零样本迁移至 ValaisCD 与 B-FLAIR-test。
AI.conclusion: BMD-CD 以线性复杂度的时序状态空间建模替代密集注意力，并借助 logit 空间扩散精修，在多种变化检测设定下取得强性能，同时保持较低计算与推理开销，具备零样本迁移能力。

title: Giving Credit Where It's Due: Redundancy-Aware Learning for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models can produce correct yet unnecessarily long reasoning traces. Existing methods improve reasoning efficiency with trajectory-level objectives or local token- and step-level signals, but rarely model inter-step semantic dependencies. This limits their ability to distinguish redundant steps from those that support later deductions, making it harder to shorten reasoning without sacrificing accuracy. We introduce RECAP (REdundancy-aware Credit Assignment via Propagation), which addresses this limitation by assigning credit where it is due based on both a step's downstream role in the reasoning structure and its contribution to solving the problem correctly. We define structural responsibility to capture the step's downstream role by measuring how strongly later reasoning depends on it, using credit propagated backward from the final-answer node through an outcome-independent, LLM-annotated semantic dependency graph. However, a step can have high structural responsibility yet steer the reasoning away from the correct solution. RECAP therefore introduces step efficacy to measure answer-directed progress through changes in gold-answer log-likelihood as each step is added. Together, these signals reshape rollout-level GRPO advantages into step-specific updates. RECAP requires neither a separately trained process reward model nor preconstructed concise trajectories. Across two 7B models and four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, RECAP improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B, it improves pass@1 by 2.0-3.7 percentage points while reducing reasoning tokens by 8%-31% relative to GRPO across all four benchmarks. Analysis suggests these savings reflect fewer reasoning operations and less dead-end reasoning, rather than more compact expression.

AI.tldr: RECAP 提出通过语义依赖图的反向信用传播与答案导向的步效度信号，重构 GRPO 优势为步级更新，在无需过程奖励模型或精简轨迹的前提下提升推理的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型常产生正确但冗长的推理链。现有方法依赖轨迹级目标或局部 token/步级信号，很少建模步与步之间的语义依赖，因而难以区分冗余步骤与支撑后续推导的关键步骤，导致缩短推理时精度受损。
AI.method: RECAP 由两个信号组成：其一为结构责任度，通过 LLM 标注的、与结果无关的语义依赖图，从最终答案节点反向传播信用，衡量后续推理对该步的依赖强度；其二为步效度，通过加入该步后金答案对数似然的变化衡量其朝正确答案的推进程度。二者结合将 rollout 级 GRPO 优势重塑为步级更新；无需单独训练过程奖励模型，也无需预先构造精简轨迹。
AI.result: 在两个 7B 模型与四个数学推理基准上，RECAP 改善了准确率-效率权衡。Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上，相对 GRPO 在四个基准上 pass@1 提升 2.0-3.7 个百分点，同时推理 token 减少 8%-31%。分析表明节省来自更少的推理操作与更少的死胡同推理，而非表达更紧凑。
AI.conclusion: 建模步间语义依赖并进行冗余感知的信用分配，可在不牺牲精度的情况下压缩推理长度，为推理效率优化提供了无需额外奖励模型或参考轨迹的通用思路。

title: The Linear Representation Hypothesis Needs a Group Action
summary: To make claims about representations that generalize beyond a particular trained model, we need to specify when two representations should count as equivalent. The Linear Representation Hypothesis is often discussed without making this equivalence explicit. Different notions of equivalence preserve different structures, so metrics, probes, and interventions that appear to study the same representation may in fact correspond to different hypotheses. We therefore argue that the Linear Representation Hypothesis is not one hypothesis but a family of claims distinguished by representation equivalence. We formalize this idea using group actions, specifying the representation object, the procedure that produces it, and the property ultimately asserted, while accounting for equivalences imposed by the model architecture. This framework clarifies how assumptions can change across metrics, reading points, and analysis stages, and we use it to audit common representation quantities and recent interpretability analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文主张线性表示假设并非单一假设，而是由"表示等价性"区分的假设族，并用群作用形式化表示对象、生成过程与断言属性，以审计常见表示度量与近期可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 关于表示泛化性的论断需要明确"两个表示何时算等价"，但线性表示假设常被讨论时未将这种等价关系显式化。不同等价概念保留不同结构，因此看似研究同一表示的度量、探针与干预可能实际对应不同假设，导致分析结论混淆。
AI.method: 以群作用为形式化工具，显式指定三要素：表示对象、产生该表示的过程、最终断言的属性，同时考虑模型架构所施加的等价性。借此框架刻画假设如何随度量、读取点与分析阶段而变化，并据此审计常用表示量与近期可解释性分析。
AI.result: 框架表明线性表示假设实为一族由表示等价性区分的假设；不同度量、读取点与分析阶段所依赖的假设可能不一致，从而解释并揭示了常见表示量及可解释性分析中的隐含分歧与潜在误判。
AI.conclusion: 应把线性表示假设视为依等价性划分的假设族，并在研究中对表示对象、生成过程与断言属性作出显式说明，以保证跨度量与跨阶段的等价性假设一致。

title: Count Evidence, Not Sentences: Tempered Evidence Fusion of LLM Judgments for Long-Text Value Measurement
comment: Yuhe Wu, Rui Qian, and Guangyu Wang contributed equally. Corresponding author: Guang Zhang. See also: https://github.com/Kzczc/ICASSP2027-TEF
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to measure public value orientations from long social media posts, yet such posts often mix background, quotations, concessions, and only a few stance-bearing sentences. Existing approaches either ask the model to predict a document-level label directly, which can be overconfident, or aggregate sentence-level predictions by majority or soft voting, which treat uncertain and decisive sentences as equally informative. We formulate long-text value measurement as a decision-fusion problem and propose Tempered Evidence Fusion (TEF), a training-free rule that weights each sentence's log-odds by its normalized information gain, as derived from a generalized Bayesian posterior. This makes the fused score nearly vanish for uncertain sentences while preserving the Bayes-optimal weight of decisive evidence. We further introduce Multi-event Insight Network Dimensions (MIND), a benchmark of 8,358 Chinese and English posts spanning five years of public events and six value dimensions. On MIND, TEF outperforms the strongest baseline among Direct, Majority Vote, and Soft Vote by an average of 4.5 accuracy points and 4.6 macro-F1 points across five LLMs and two languages. MIND dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Kzczc/ICASSP2027-TEF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tempered Evidence Fusion (TEF)，一种无需训练的规则，通过按归一化信息增益对句子log-odds加权来融合长文本价值取向测量，并构建MIND基准，在5个LLM、2种语言上平均提升4.5个准确率点和4.6个宏F1点。
AI.motivation: 长社交媒体帖子常混合背景、引用、让步等大量非立场句子，仅少数句子承载立场。现有方法要么直接预测文档级标签（易过度自信），要么用多数投票或软投票聚合句子级预测（将不确定句与决定性句等同对待），均未合理处理证据的可靠性差异。
AI.method: 将长文本价值测量形式化为决策融合问题，提出TEF：一种无需训练的规则，基于广义贝叶斯后验导出的归一化信息增益，对每个句子的log-odds进行加权，使不确定句子的融合分数趋近于零，同时保留决定性证据的贝叶斯最优权重。此外构建MIND基准，涵盖8,358条中英帖子、五年公共事件、六个价值维度。
AI.result: 在MIND上，TEF在Direct、Majority Vote、Soft Vote中最强基线基础上，跨5个LLM和2种语言平均提升4.5个准确率点和4.6个宏F1点。数据集与代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: TEF通过按证据信息量加权融合句子级log-odds，有效缓解长文本中噪声句子的干扰，在跨模型、跨语言的价值取向量化任务上均优于直接预测与投票式聚合基线。
